選殖

blocks.en: Three cloning pipelines ran side by side all season, and the write-up below keeps them apart. One put the four-module light circuit together. One built every protectant cargo behind a constitutive promoter, so that a cargo could be tested without the light gate on top of it. One worked out how to get a plasmid through the wall of Bacillus subtilis at all. Twelve DBTL cycles between them, and each pipeline handed the other two something it could not have made alone.
blocks.text: Three cloning pipelines ran side by side all season, and the write-up below keeps them apart. One put the four-module light circuit together. One built every protectant cargo behind a constitutive promoter, so that a cargo could be tested without the light gate on top of it. One worked out how to get a plasmid through the wall of Bacillus subtilis at all. Twelve DBTL cycles between them, and each pipeline handed the other two something it could not have made alone.
blocks.zh: 整季有三條選殖流程並行，下面的紀錄把它們分開寫。一條把四模組的光迴路組起來。一條把每一種保護劑載荷都接在組成型啟動子後面，讓載荷可以在沒有光閘的情況下單獨測試。一條則是在摸索質體究竟要怎麼穿過枯草桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）的細胞壁。三者加起來共十二個 DBTL 循環，而每一條流程都交給另外兩條一些它自己做不出來的東西。

blocks.en: Pipeline 1, the inducible circuit, is five cycles that put four transcription units into one plasmid so that green light gates the protectant. Pipeline 2, the constitutive output module, is five cycles that build every cargo with no light gate in front of it, so a cargo can be tested on its own. Pipeline 3 is two cycles of electroporation, one per strain, measured in colonies recovered. They are not independent: pipeline 2 is where a protectant cassette is first sequence-verified, and those verified inserts are what pipeline 1 assembles into Level 2, with the codon-optimized ACC deaminase that pipeline 2 designed as the cargo the finished light circuit delivers. Pipeline 3 is the last step for both, and it is also where the project changed host: the voltage sweeps there are what showed the assembled 10 kb plasmid could be recovered at all.

blocks.zh: 流程 1 是誘導型迴路，五個循環把四個轉錄單元放進同一個質體，讓綠光能夠開關保護劑。流程 2 是組成型輸出模組，五個循環把每一種載荷都建成前面不帶光閘的形式，使載荷可以單獨測試。流程 3 是電穿孔，兩個循環，一株菌一個，以回收到的菌落數衡量。三者並不獨立：流程 2 是保護劑卡匣第一次通過定序確認的地方，而那些確認過的插入片段正是流程 1 組裝成 Level 2 的材料，其中流程 2 設計的密碼子最佳化 ACC 去胺酶，就是完成的光迴路所要遞送的載荷。流程 3 是前兩者的最後一步，也是計畫換宿主的地方：那裡的電壓掃描，正是顯示組裝好的 10 kb 質體究竟能不能被回收的依據。
誘導型迴路

blocks.en: The first plan was to let the bacterium sense stress for itself. The reason it is light-gated instead is that a stress threshold is not a property of the stress, it is a property of the crop. At 30 °C a potato is already in trouble, because tuber formation is fully inhibited above 25 °C [16], while sorghum is still inside its optimal range and only starts losing yield above 32.5 °C [17]. A circuit tuned to one of those crops is wrong for the other, so the threshold was moved out of the cell and into a microcontroller that watches the field and decides when to switch the light on. That is what the four-component optogenetic circuit below is for.

blocks.zh: 最初的計畫是讓細菌自己感測逆境。後來改成以光閘控制，原因是逆境閾值並不是逆境本身的性質，而是作物的性質。在 30 °C 下馬鈴薯已經有麻煩，因為塊莖形成在 25 °C 以上就完全受到抑制 [16]；而高粱此時仍在最適範圍內，要到 32.5 °C 以上才開始損失產量 [17]。為其中一種作物調好的迴路，對另一種就是錯的，因此閾值被移出細胞，交給一顆監看田間、決定何時開燈的微控制器。下面那組四元件光遺傳迴路就是為此而設。

blocks.en: Based on the characterization of the CcaS/CcaR optogenetic system reported in Castillo-Hair 2019 [1], we redesigned the optogenetic circuits with the coding sequences of the green/red light-responsive two-component system (CcaSm3 and CcaR), the PCB production enzyme (ho1-pcyA fusion) and our target output and reporter coding sequences (LEA14, ACCD, BoPep4) by the modular cloning (MoClo) system [3], because we were unable to obtain the SubtiToolKit.

blocks.en: Colony PCR was performed to screen transformants for successful Level 1 Golden Gate assembly; however, the cloning efficiency was low and the results were inconsistent. Amplified fragments were analyzed via agarose gel electrophoresis to assess insert size. A subset of colonies yielding bands near the expected sizes were supposed to be selected for plasmid isolation and subsequent restriction digest verification. blocks.zh: 我們以菌落 PCR 篩選轉形株，確認 Level 1 Golden Gate 組裝是否成功；然而選殖效率低，結果也不一致。擴增片段以瓊脂凝膠電泳分析，評估插入片段大小。原本預計挑出條帶接近預期大小的一部分菌落，進行質體萃取與後續的限制酵素切割確認。所有試驗都未成功，因此沒有數據可以呈現。
L學習

blocks.en: Colony PCR screening and restriction digests revealed high background, including potentially empty vectors and incorrect inserts, making it difficult to distinguish from assembly failures and PCR artifacts. We learned that attempting Level 1 assembly straight from unverified PCR products introduced considerable ambiguity, highlighting the need for an intermediate cloning step to generate clean, sequence-verified Level 0 entry parts to optimize cloning success.
blocks.text: Colony PCR screening and restriction digests revealed high background, including potentially empty vectors and incorrect inserts, making it difficult to distinguish from assembly failures and PCR artifacts. We learned that attempting Level 1 assembly straight from unverified PCR products introduced considerable ambiguity, highlighting the need for an intermediate cloning step to generate clean, sequence-verified Level 0 entry parts to optimize cloning success.
blocks.zh: 菌落 PCR 篩選與限制酵素切割都顯示背景很高，可能包含空載體與錯誤插入，難以與組裝失敗及 PCR 假訊號區分。我們學到：直接用未經確認的 PCR 產物做 Level 1 組裝會帶來相當大的不確定性，因此需要一個中間選殖步驟，先做出乾淨、經定序確認的 Level 0 入門元件，以提高選殖成功率。

blocks.en: In response to the issue identified in DBTL cycle 1, we realized that an intermediate cloning step, in which the inserts are first cloned into Level 0 vectors, was necessary. Since we had unreliable outcomes in our earlier assembly, including inconsistent colony PCR results and unconfirmed clones, we revisited the cloning strategy at the PCR and vector-entry stage to improve reliability before moving into Level 1 Golden Gate assembly. The overall part composition for each module remained unchanged from DBTL 1; the redesign targeted the intermediate cloning steps used to generate clean, verified Level 0 parts.

B建構

blocks.en: We amplified each module’s coding sequence by PCR and cloned the amplicon into a pGEM-T Easy vector [5]. pGEM-T Easy provides a direct, rapid method for cloning PCR products through TA cloning: the vector is supplied pre-linearized with single 3′-thymidine (T) overhangs, which are complementary to the single 3′-adenosine (A) overhangs left on PCR products by Taq and other non-proofreading polymerases. This complementarity allows the amplicon to ligate directly into the vector without any additional processing, making it a fast and efficient intermediate cloning strategy compared to attempting Golden Gate entry directly from a PCR product.

This complementarity allows the amplicon to ligate directly into the vector without any additional processing, making it a fast and efficient intermediate cloning strategy compared to attempting Golden Gate entry directly from a PCR product.
blocks.zh: 我們以 PCR 擴增每個模組的編碼序列，並把擴增產物選殖進 pGEM-T Easy 載體 [5]。pGEM-T Easy 透過 TA 選殖提供一條直接而快速的 PCR 產物選殖途徑：這個載體供應時已預先線性化，帶有單一 3′ 胸腺嘧啶（T）突出端，正好與 Taq 等不具校對功能的聚合酶留在 PCR 產物上的單一 3′ 腺嘌呤（A）突出端互補。這種互補性讓擴增產物不需任何額外處理就能直接接進載體，比起直接從 PCR 產物進行 Golden Gate 入門，是一個快速而有效率的中間選殖策略。

T測試

blocks.en: Colonies from the pGEM-T Easy transformations were screened by colony PCR, and PCR products were run on an agarose gel alongside a DNA ladder to assess assembly success. A correct colony PCR band was one that ran at the expected size, calculated as the length between T7 promoter and SP6 promoter amplified by the screening primers; this confirms that a DNA fragment of the correct length was successfully ligated into the vector at the expected position. Colonies producing a single, clean band at this expected size were considered positive candidates for the correct insert. In contrast, colonies producing bands of incorrect or unexpected sizes were classified as negative and excluded from further analysis, since these patterns indicate either an empty vector or a truncated or mis-priming product rather than the intended insert.

blocks.zh: 來自 pGEM-T Easy 轉形的菌落以菌落 PCR 篩選，PCR 產物與 DNA 梯度標記一起跑瓊脂凝膠，以評估組裝是否成功。正確的菌落 PCR 條帶會落在預期大小，也就是篩選引子所擴增的 T7 啟動子到 SP6 啟動子之間的長度；這表示長度正確的 DNA 片段已成功接進載體的預期位置。在這個預期大小處出現單一乾淨條帶的菌落，視為帶有正確插入片段的陽性候選。相對地，條帶大小不正確或不符預期的菌落列為陰性並排除於後續分析，因為這些樣式表示的是空載體、截短片段或錯誤黏合的產物，而不是我們要的插入片段。

L學習

blocks.en: The pGEM-T Easy TA cloning step proved to be a fast and reliable way to generate verified Level 0 entry material before doing Golden Gate assembly. Because colony PCR alone can only confirm that an insert of approximately the correct size is present, and cannot rule out point mutations or small indels introduced during PCR amplification, we relied on sequencing rather than enzyme digestion to confirm the fidelity of each cloned insert; we did not perform additional restriction digest verification at this stage, since correct band size on colony PCR, combined with full-length sequencing, was considered sufficient to confirm the sequence accuracy of each insert before proceeding to Level 1 assembly.

blocks.en: The four modules divide the work of the circuit. The PCB production module initiates chromophore production by expressing the heme oxygenase 1 and phycocyanobilin:ferredoxin oxidoreductase fusion enzyme, which converts endogenous cellular heme into active phycocyanobilin, the chromophore the photoreceptor needs: Ho1 oxidizes heme to biliverdin IXα, and PcyA then reduces the biliverdin to PCB. The light-sensing module contains the ccaSm3 gene, an optimized variant of the green-light responsive histidine kinase photoreceptor CcaS. Instead of being induced by xylose or IPTG as in Castillo-Hair 2019 [1], this module is driven by the constitutive promoters PlepA and PliaG, so the receptor is expressed constantly and the system responds continuously to green light. The transduction module encodes the CcaR response regulator; on photon absorption the activated CcaSm3 kinase transfers a phosphoryl group to CcaR, switching it into its active, DNA-binding state. The light-responsive expression module contains the target gene cassette behind the green-light inducible promoter PcpcG2-veg. Phosphorylated CcaR binds that promoter to drive expression of the protectant only when green light is present, which reduces leakage and lowers the metabolic burden on the bacteria when plants are not under stress. We equipped an E. coli expression blocking device as our composite ribosome binding site to prevent leakage of toxic genes before the construct reaches Bacillus subtilis.

blocks.zh: 四個模組把迴路的工作分開。PCB 生成模組表現血基質氧化酶 1 與 phycocyanobilin:ferredoxin 氧化還原酶的融合酵素，啟動發色團的生成，把細胞內源的血基質轉換成具活性的 phycocyanobilin，也就是光受體所需的發色團：Ho1 把血基質氧化成 biliverdin IXα，PcyA 再把 biliverdin 還原成 PCB。光感測模組帶有 ccaSm3 基因，是綠光反應型組胺酸激酶光受體 CcaS 的最佳化變體。它不像 Castillo-Hair 2019 [1] 那樣以木糖或 IPTG 誘導，而是由組成型啟動子 PlepA 與 PliaG 驅動，因此受體持續表現，系統也持續對綠光反應。訊息傳導模組編碼 CcaR 反應調節子；吸收光子後，活化的 CcaSm3 激酶會把一個磷醯基轉給 CcaR，使其切換到可結合 DNA 的活性狀態。光反應表現模組把目標基因卡匣放在綠光誘導型啟動子 PcpcG2-veg 之後。磷酸化的 CcaR 結合該啟動子，只有在有綠光時才驅動保護劑的表現，這樣可以減少滲漏，也在植物未遭受逆境時降低細菌的代謝負擔。我們加裝了一個 E. coli 表現阻斷裝置作為複合核醣體結合位，以防止構築抵達枯草桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）之前毒性基因的滲漏。

blocks.en: After DBTL 2, we further optimized our STK cloning strategy (v2) in response to a compatibility issue identified with the pGEM-T Easy intermediate cloning step: the pGEM-T Easy vector uses the same antibiotic resistance gene (ampicillin) as our Level 1 destination vectors (1A, 1B, 1C, 1D), which complicated downstream selection and increased the risk of background contamination from carryover vector during Golden Gate assembly. To resolve this, we redesigned our cloning approach to construct each module’s coding sequence directly using STK Level 0 primers, skipping the pGEM-T Easy intermediate altogether. This step was only relevant to the CDS not cloned into pGEM-T Easy, as the ones from DBTL 2 were still usable in Level 1 Golden Gate assembly.

L學習

blocks.en: Although this approach resolved the antibiotic resistance conflict, a separate concern arose regarding potential recombination events in Bacillus subtilis [7]. Because several of our modules share repeated regulatory sequences (for example Pveg, RBS0, B0015) across multiple constructs, we became concerned that homologous recombination between repeated elements, once all four modules were combined in B. subtilis, could destabilize parts of the assembled optogenetic circuit, potentially weakening the CcaS/CcaR signals. Specifically, if a construct contains repeating sequences, such as duplicated promoters or terminators, the host’s recombination system can recognize them as matching regions and recombine them. This deletes the DNA lying between the repeated parts, rearranging the construct or shuffling them so that the cells end up carrying a shortened or altered version of the original design. These deletion variants can take over the culture, leading to loss of expression and inconsistent results between experiments. This concern motivated us to reconsider the repeated part usage across our modules going into the next design cycle.
blocks.text: Although this approach resolved the antibiotic resistance conflict, a separate concern arose regarding potential recombination events in Bacillus subtilis [7]. Because several of our modules share repeated regulatory sequences (for example Pveg, RBS0, B0015) across multiple constructs, we became concerned that homologous recombination between repeated elements, once all four modules were combined in B. subtilis, could destabilize parts of the assembled optogenetic circuit, potentially weakening the CcaS/CcaR signals. Specifically, if a construct contains repeating sequences, such as duplicated promoters or terminators, the host’s recombination system can recognize them as matching regions and recombine them. This deletes the DNA lying between the repeated parts, rearranging the construct or shuffling them so that the cells end up carrying a shortened or altered version of the original design. These deletion variants can take over the culture, leading to loss of expression and inconsistent results between experiments. This concern motivated us to reconsider the repeated part usage across our modules going into the next design cycle.
blocks.zh: 雖然這個做法解決了抗生素抗性的衝突，卻另外帶出一個關於 Bacillus subtilis 中可能發生重組事件的顧慮 [7]。由於我們有幾個模組在多個構築中共用重複的調控序列（例如 Pveg、RBS0、B0015），我們擔心一旦四個模組都放進 B. subtilis，重複元件之間的同源重組會破壞已組裝好的光遺傳迴路的某些部分，可能削弱 CcaS/CcaR 的訊號。具體來說，如果一個構築含有重複序列，例如重複的啟動子或終止子，宿主的重組系統可能把它們認成相符的區域而加以重組。這會刪掉夾在重複元件之間的 DNA，使構築重排或被打散，細胞最後帶著比原始設計更短或已被改動的版本。這些缺失變體可能在培養中佔上優勢，導致表現消失，實驗之間的結果也不一致。這個顧慮促使我們在進入下一個設計循環時，重新考慮模組之間重複元件的使用。

D設計

blocks.en: To address the recombination risk identified in DBTL 3, we developed a third version of our SubtiToolKit design (v3) aimed at reducing sequence redundancy across the four modules of our optogenetic circuit. Rather than reusing identical regulatory parts (promoter, RBS, terminator) across multiple modules, we diversified these elements in module 1 to minimize the length and number of repeated sequences that could serve as substrates for homologous recombination in B. subtilis.
blocks.text: To address the recombination risk identified in DBTL 3, we developed a third version of our SubtiToolKit design (v3) aimed at reducing sequence redundancy across the four modules of our optogenetic circuit. Rather than reusing identical regulatory parts (promoter, RBS, terminator) across multiple modules, we diversified these elements in module 1 to minimize the length and number of repeated sequences that could serve as substrates for homologous recombination in B. subtilis.
blocks.zh: 為了處理 DBTL 3 所發現的重組風險，我們發展出 SubtiToolKit 設計的第三版（v3），目標是降低光遺傳迴路四個模組之間的序列重複。我們不再在多個模組中重用相同的調控元件（啟動子、RBS、終止子），而是把模組 1 的這些元件換成不同的版本，以盡量減少可能成為 B. subtilis 同源重組基質的重複序列的長度與數量。
B建構

blocks.en: We modified the affected constructs by substituting the promoter, RBS, and/or terminator with alternative STK parts for module 1, distinct from those used elsewhere in the circuit, while preserving its coding sequence. This was intended to maintain equivalent transcriptional and translational output while breaking up long stretches of sequence identity shared between modules.

blocks.en: We screened 12 colonies carrying the redesigned module 1 (P<sub>tagC</sub>+RBS-Ho1:pcyA-L3S2P21) by colony PCR with the BioBrick prefix forward primer and the STK-seq reverse primer. 11 of the 12 colonies gave a band at the expected size of 1833 bp, and only colony A11 failed. Clone 1 was then sequence verified and later used for Level 2 assembly.

D設計

blocks.en: Having successfully verified the independent Level 1 modules (PCB production, CcaS light sensing, CcaR transduction, and ACC deaminase light-responsive expression) through colony PCR and sequencing in previous cycles, the next objective was to combine them into a fully functional, multi-gene optogenetic circuit. For Level 2 assembly, the four individual Level 1 transcription units needed to be cloned into a single Level 2 shuttle vector from the STK library. The design also integrated experimental validation in two Bacillus subtilis strains. We initially enacted functional testing using our 168 strain, but we later received the B. subtilis WB800 strain from Professor Huang, which has eight extracellular proteases deleted (NprE, AprE, Epr, Bpr, Mpr, NprB, Vpr and WprA) [12]. Because the 168 transformations were limiting our progress, we decided to use the WB800 strain as an alternative host for the Level 2 construct. The construct was left unchanged, and only the host strain and the electroporation conditions were reconsidered. WB800 is deficient in extracellular proteases, which is also expected to benefit a secreted output such as ACC deaminase. Specifically, WB800 is a derivative of the six protease-deficient strain WB600, in which the Vpr protease and the cell-wall protease WprA were also inactivated; the commercially available version was built to increase the stability of secreted proteins by removing all eight. Because ACC deaminase is a secreted, His-tagged output, a protease-deficient host reduces degradation after secretion and makes the protein easier to detect on Western blots. Western blotting and ELISA were used to verify and quantify light-inducible protein expression, while a DNPH assay measured ACC deaminase activity under controlled green against red light.

blocks.zh: 在先前的循環中，獨立的 Level 1 模組（PCB 生成、CcaS 光感測、CcaR 訊息傳導，以及 ACC 去胺酶的光反應表現）都已經以菌落 PCR 與定序成功確認，下一個目標就是把它們合成一個完整可用的多基因光遺傳迴路。Level 2 組裝需要把四個獨立的 Level 1 轉錄單元選殖進 STK 庫中的單一 Level 2 穿梭載體。這個設計也把實驗驗證放進兩個 Bacillus subtilis 菌株。我們一開始用 168 菌株做功能測試，後來從Professor Huang那裡收到 B. subtilis WB800 菌株，這一株刪除了八個胞外蛋白酶（NprE、AprE、Epr、Bpr、Mpr、NprB、Vpr 與 WprA）[12]。由於 168 的轉形一直限制我們的進度，我們決定改用 WB800 作為 Level 2 構築的替代宿主。構築本身沒有改動，只重新考慮宿主菌株與電穿孔條件。WB800 缺少胞外蛋白酶，預期對 ACC 去胺酶這類分泌型輸出也有好處。具體來說，WB800 衍生自缺六種蛋白酶的 WB600 菌株，其中 Vpr 蛋白酶與細胞壁蛋白酶 WprA 也被去活化；市售版本就是為了把八種全部移除、提高分泌蛋白質的穩定性而建立的。由於 ACC 去胺酶是帶 His 標籤的分泌型輸出，缺蛋白酶的宿主可以減少分泌後的降解，也讓蛋白質在西方墨點法上更容易偵測。我們以西方墨點法與 ELISA 確認並定量光誘導的蛋白質表現，並以 DNPH 檢測量測受控綠光對紅光下的 ACC 去胺酶活性。
B建構

blocks.en: To construct the integrated Level 2 optogenetic system, we performed Golden Gate assembly, combining the sequence-verified STK Level 1 transcription units: the PCB production module, the ccaS-m3 light sensing module, the ccaR transcriptional module, and the PcpcG2-veg light responsive expression module. Following cloning in E. coli and sequencing confirmation, the fully assembled Level 2 expression plasmid was electroporated into Bacillus subtilis strains 168 and WB800 at 2.1 kV to 2.3 kV.

Following cloning in E. coli and sequencing confirmation, the fully assembled Level 2 expression plasmid was electroporated into Bacillus subtilis strains 168 and WB800 at 2.1 kV to 2.3 kV.
blocks.zh: 為了建構整合的 Level 2 光遺傳系統，我們進行 Golden Gate 組裝，把經定序確認的 STK Level 1 轉錄單元合在一起：PCB 生成模組、ccaS-m3 光感測模組、ccaR 轉錄模組，以及 PcpcG2-veg 光反應表現模組。在 E. coli 中完成選殖並經定序確認後，組裝完成的 Level 2 表現質體以 2.1 kV 至 2.3 kV 電穿孔進 Bacillus subtilis 168 與 WB800 菌株。

T測試

blocks.en: Three consecutive Golden Gate rounds returned nothing with no design change between them. On 28 August the insert-to-vector ratio was swept at 1:5 and 1:7 and both returned positives at all three junctions. The assembled plasmid was then cut with EcoRI alone and with EcoRI and BtsI together, and both clones gave the sizes a correct assembly predicts. Positive colonies were grown into culture and, following plasmid purification, the constructs were electroporated into B. subtilis strains 168 and WB800. Colonies from the electroporation plates were inoculated and grown at 37 °C overnight. To test the optogenetic functionality of the integrated circuit, cells were cultured and run under our light plate apparatus to compare the production of ACC deaminase under red light and green light. Supernatants were collected and analyzed by Western blot, DNPH assay and ELISA; those blots and the series they belong to are on Results, not repeated here.

blocks.zh: 連續三輪 Golden Gate 都沒有結果，而且三輪之間沒有任何設計改動。8 月 28 日掃描了 1:5 與 1:7 的插入片段對載體比例，兩者在三個接點都得到陽性。組裝完成的質體接著分別用 EcoRI 單切、以及 EcoRI 加 BtsI 雙切，兩個選殖株都給出正確組裝所預測的大小。陽性菌落培養起來，質體純化之後，構築電穿孔進 B. subtilis 168 與 WB800 菌株。電穿孔培養盤上的菌落接種後在 37 °C 隔夜培養。為了測試整合迴路的光遺傳功能，細胞經培養後放進我們的光照板裝置，比較紅光與綠光下 ACC 去胺酶的產生。上清液收集後以西方墨點法、DNPH 檢測與 ELISA 分析；那些墨點圖與它們所屬的系列放在結果頁，這裡不重複。
L學習

blocks.en: Although successful, we ultimately learned that the electroporation of Level 2 Golden Gate assembly constructs was extremely difficult, as the constructs are over 10 kb, and that in future we should look towards other alternatives such as natural transformation, which might have made the process easier and faster. Furthermore, we also learned that in the process of determining whether or not we have the correct construct, one module being positive does not necessarily determine the state of the rest of the modules; as a result, it is imperative that we validate the accuracy of all modules following the cloning process.
blocks.text: Although successful, we ultimately learned that the electroporation of Level 2 Golden Gate assembly constructs was extremely difficult, as the constructs are over 10 kb, and that in future we should look towards other alternatives such as natural transformation, which might have made the process easier and faster. Furthermore, we also learned that in the process of determining whether or not we have the correct construct, one module being positive does not necessarily determine the state of the rest of the modules; as a result, it is imperative that we validate the accuracy of all modules following the cloning process.
blocks.zh: 雖然最後成功了，我們也學到 Level 2 Golden Gate 組裝構築的電穿孔極為困難，因為構築超過 10 kb；未來應該考慮其他替代做法，例如自然轉形，可能會讓過程更容易也更快。此外我們也學到，在判斷手上是不是正確構築的過程中，某一個模組是陽性並不代表其餘模組的狀態；因此在選殖之後，一定要驗證所有模組的正確性。

blocks.en: Unfortunately, we were unable to recover the Level 2 Csn-AcdS-Histag strain (ABDI, the wild-type cargo) in liquid culture from its glycerol stock, so we inoculated cultures directly from colonies on the electroporation plate instead. Although this worked, it means that future experiments should rely on freshly transformed colonies, and we will need to revisit our glycerol stock preparation and storage to make the strain reliably recoverable.

blocks.en: 19 September 2026, the strongest cloning evidence the project has. Three ACDI clones, X1, X3 and X9, across three junctions: junction A, L2 pcyA F with L2 CcaSm3 R, 375 bp; junction B, L2 CcaSm3 F with CcaR R, 632 bp; junction C, CcaR F with Csn R, 661 bp. Nine correct junctions say the four modules are joined in the right order in three separate clones. They say nothing about the sequence between the junctions.

blocks.en: One oddity is on record and unexplained. On our Western blots, the Level 2 Csn-AcdS-Histag construct ran at a lower apparent molecular weight than the Level 2 SamyQ-AcdS 2.1-Histag construct. The two constructs encode the same mature ACC deaminase sequence and differ only in their signal peptides and codon usage, and neither difference is large enough to explain the size shift we observed. We hypothesize that it may reflect differences in how the protein assembles: ACC deaminase can form oligomers, and the Csn-AcdS construct may represent a dimer, whereas the SamyQ-AcdS 2.1 one may form a higher order oligomer or aggregate that runs larger. We were not able to quantify aggregation, so this theory remains untested. Importantly, the larger SamyQ-AcdS 2.1 is still active as shown by our DNPH assay results, which suggests that the size difference does not prevent ACC deaminase function.

We hypothesize that it may reflect differences in how the protein assembles: ACC deaminase can form oligomers, and the Csn-AcdS construct may represent a dimer, whereas the SamyQ-AcdS 2.1 one may form a higher order oligomer or aggregate that runs larger. We were not able to quantify aggregation, so this theory remains untested. Importantly, the larger SamyQ-AcdS 2.1 is still active as shown by our DNPH assay results, which suggests that the size difference does not prevent ACC deaminase function.
blocks.zh: 有一個怪現象記錄下來但沒有解釋。在我們的西方墨點圖上，Level 2 的 Csn-AcdS-Histag 構築跑出來的表觀分子量比 Level 2 的 SamyQ-AcdS 2.1-Histag 構築低。兩個構築編碼相同的成熟 ACC 去胺酶序列，只在訊號胜肽與密碼子使用上不同，而這兩項差異都不足以解釋我們看到的大小位移。我們推測這可能反映蛋白質組裝方式的差異：ACC 去胺酶會形成寡聚體，Csn-AcdS 構築可能是二聚體，而 SamyQ-AcdS 2.1 可能形成更高階的寡聚體或聚集體，因而跑得比較大。我們無法定量聚集程度，所以這個說法仍未經檢驗。值得注意的是，較大的 SamyQ-AcdS 2.1 依我們的 DNPH 檢測結果仍具活性，這顯示大小差異並未妨礙 ACC 去胺酶的功能。

blocks.en: Every cargo the light circuit was meant to express was also built behind the constitutive promoter P<sub>veg</sub>, in a shuttle vector that replicates in both organisms. The point is separation of causes: if a protectant cannot be detected, this pipeline says whether the problem is the protectant or the switch in front of it. Two reporter cycles failed before the cargoes themselves were built, and the last two cycles leave the assembly alone and work on the cargo sequence itself.

D設計

blocks.en: Since we were unable to directly detect our protectants by visual or colorimetric assays in Bacillus subtilis, we first used a chromoprotein as a reporter to validate the feasibility of our circuit rapidly. A chromoprotein provides visible coloration and measurable absorbance, so a colony can be judged by eye then quantified by absorbance measurement on a plate reader without waiting for a Western blot. To this end, we designed the expression modules with the constitutive promoter Pveg to continuously drive the expression of the AmilCP reporter chromoprotein in Bacillus subtilis. The AmilCP was designed to fuse with the secretion signal peptide (SamyQ or Csn) for protein secretion, as well as a C-terminal 6×His tag for detection. We chose AmilCP because it produces a visible blue-purple coloration and has a high extinction coefficient, which allows detection at low expression levels.

A chromoprotein provides visible coloration and measurable absorbance, so a colony can be judged by eye then quantified by absorbance measurement on a plate reader without waiting for a Western blot. To this end, we designed the expression modules with the constitutive promoter Pveg to continuously drive the expression of the AmilCP reporter chromoprotein in Bacillus subtilis. The AmilCP was designed to fuse with the secretion signal peptide (SamyQ or Csn) for protein secretion, as well as a C-terminal 6×His tag for detection. We chose AmilCP because it produces a visible blue-purple coloration and has a high extinction coefficient, which allows detection at low expression levels.
blocks.zh: 由於我們無法在 Bacillus subtilis 中以目視或比色檢測直接偵測保護劑，我們先用一個色素蛋白作為報導基因，快速驗證迴路的可行性。色素蛋白會產生可見的顏色與可量測的吸光值，因此菌落可以先用肉眼判斷，再以盤式讀取儀量吸光值定量，不必等西方墨點法。為此，我們以組成型啟動子 Pveg 設計表現模組，持續驅動 AmilCP 報導色素蛋白在 Bacillus subtilis 中的表現。AmilCP 設計成與分泌訊號胜肽（SamyQ 或 Csn）融合以便分泌，並在 C 端帶 6×His 標籤以供偵測。我們選 AmilCP，是因為它會產生可見的藍紫色，而且莫耳吸光係數高，在低表現量下也能偵測到。

blocks.en: To test secretion and not only expression, AmilCP was fused to a secretion signal peptide with a C-terminal 6×His tag, so that the protein could be tracked both by color and by anti-His Western blot. We tested two signal peptides, SamyQ and Csn, because the best signal peptide for our protectants was unknown and the reporter allowed us to compare them on the same cargo protein.
blocks.text: To test secretion and not only expression, AmilCP was fused to a secretion signal peptide with a C-terminal 6×His tag, so that the protein could be tracked both by color and by anti-His Western blot. We tested two signal peptides, SamyQ and Csn, because the best signal peptide for our protectants was unknown and the reporter allowed us to compare them on the same cargo protein.
blocks.zh: 為了測試分泌而不只是表現，AmilCP 與分泌訊號胜肽融合並在 C 端帶 6×His 標籤，使蛋白質既能以顏色追蹤，也能用抗 His 的西方墨點法追蹤。我們測了兩種訊號胜肽，SamyQ 與 Csn，因為當時還不知道哪一種最適合我們的保護劑，而報導基因讓我們可以在同一個載荷蛋白上比較它們。

blocks.en: In addition, because ACC deaminase functions intracellularly, we asked whether it could be taken up by plant cells. We therefore introduced a cell-penetrating peptide, which has been reported to mediate direct entry into plant cells. Constructs 3 and 4 contain a TAT cell-penetrating peptide bearing an HA tag between the signal peptide and the coding sequence, so that the protein is exported from B. subtilis and then taken up by the plant cell. That gave us a second strategy for delivering the protectants into plant cells, on the same cargo the first two constructs test.

blocks.zh: 此外，由於 ACC 去胺酶是在細胞內作用，我們也想知道它能不能被植物細胞吸收。因此我們引入一段細胞穿膜胜肽，文獻報告它能介導直接進入植物細胞。構築 3 與 4 在訊號胜肽與編碼序列之間放了一段帶 HA 標籤的 TAT 細胞穿膜胜肽，讓蛋白質先從 B. subtilis 輸出，再被植物細胞吸收。這給了我們第二種把保護劑送進植物細胞的策略，而且用的是前兩個構築所測試的同一個載荷。

T測試

blocks.en: To verify the assembly of our constructs, we used colony PCR, gel electrophoresis, and sequencing. Colonies obtained from the transformation were screened by colony PCR to confirm that the reporter cassette had been incorporated into the vector, and the PCR products were analyzed on an agarose gel to check that the fragments matched the expected size of around 8000 bp, which rules out colonies with incomplete or incorrect assembly. When the products were sent for sequencing, the results showed significant problems with our cloning and building process. Many gels showed fragments close to the expected size, but sequencing showed that they did not contain the construct we wanted. After repeated rounds of screening, we obtained colonies in which the complete construct was confirmed by sequencing.
blocks.text: To verify the assembly of our constructs, we used colony PCR, gel electrophoresis, and sequencing. Colonies obtained from the transformation were screened by colony PCR to confirm that the reporter cassette had been incorporated into the vector, and the PCR products were analyzed on an agarose gel to check that the fragments matched the expected size of around 8000 bp, which rules out colonies with incomplete or incorrect assembly. When the products were sent for sequencing, the results showed significant problems with our cloning and building process. Many gels showed fragments close to the expected size, but sequencing showed that they did not contain the construct we wanted. After repeated rounds of screening, we obtained colonies in which the complete construct was confirmed by sequencing.
blocks.zh: 為了確認構築的組裝，我們用了菌落 PCR、凝膠電泳與定序。轉形得到的菌落以菌落 PCR 篩選，確認報導卡匣是否已併入載體，PCR 產物再以瓊脂凝膠分析，檢查片段是否符合約 8000 bp 的預期大小，以排除組裝不完整或錯誤的菌落。產物送去定序後，結果顯示我們的選殖與建構流程有明顯的問題。許多膠上出現接近預期大小的片段，但定序顯示它們並不含我們要的構築。經過反覆多輪篩選，我們終於得到完整構築經定序確認的菌落。
L學習

blocks.en: The repeated unsuccessful cloning showed us that a band of the expected size on a gel was not enough to tell a correct clone from an incorrect one, so sequencing had to remain our deciding check.
blocks.text: The repeated unsuccessful cloning showed us that a band of the expected size on a gel was not enough to tell a correct clone from an incorrect one, so sequencing had to remain our deciding check.
blocks.zh: 反覆的選殖失敗讓我們看到，膠上出現預期大小的條帶並不足以分辨正確與錯誤的選殖株，因此定序必須始終是我們的決定性檢查。

blocks.en: Although the constructs were successfully assembled and sequence-verified, no coloration was observed. We attribute this to two limitations of AmilCP as a secreted reporter. First, AmilCP folds rapidly in the cytoplasm, whereas the Sec-dependent pathway requires substrates to remain unfolded during translocation, so folded AmilCP fails to be exported. Second, even if the protein were translocated, the extracellular environment may not allow it to fold correctly or to develop color. In view of this, we changed the reporter from AmilCP to β-galactosidase, encoded by the endogenous B. subtilis gene ganA.
blocks.text: Although the constructs were successfully assembled and sequence-verified, no coloration was observed. We attribute this to two limitations of AmilCP as a secreted reporter. First, AmilCP folds rapidly in the cytoplasm, whereas the Sec-dependent pathway requires substrates to remain unfolded during translocation, so folded AmilCP fails to be exported. Second, even if the protein were translocated, the extracellular environment may not allow it to fold correctly or to develop color. In view of this, we changed the reporter from AmilCP to β-galactosidase, encoded by the endogenous B. subtilis gene ganA.
blocks.zh: 雖然構築成功組裝並經定序確認，卻沒有觀察到任何顏色。我們把這歸因於 AmilCP 作為分泌型報導基因的兩個限制。第一，AmilCP 在細胞質中迅速摺疊，而 Sec 依賴路徑要求受質在跨膜運送時保持未摺疊狀態，因此已摺疊的 AmilCP 無法被輸出。第二，即使蛋白質被運送出去，胞外環境也可能不允許它正確摺疊或顯色。有鑑於此，我們把報導基因從 AmilCP 換成 β-半乳糖苷酶，由 B. subtilis 的內源基因 ganA 編碼。

D設計

blocks.en: Because AmilCP folds rapidly in the cell, it is a poor substrate for Sec-dependent secretion, which led us to search for a reporter that does not have this limitation. We chose GanA, which is not only directly available in the SubtiToolKit but also endogenous to Bacillus subtilis. GanA encodes a β-galactosidase and provides a rapid visual readout using X-gal or ONPG. This design allows researchers to easily identify correct constructs without requiring additional assays, and, as in the previous cycle, it serves as a test trial to visualize the growth and protein secretion of the given proteins within our bioreactor. The reporter was designed with the same architecture as the other constructs, so that the result could be compared directly with ACCD, LEA14 and BoPep4. The two constructs differ only in the promoter in front of the cassette, the strong 3P promoter against the light-responsive PcpcG2.

blocks.en: Because we were not able to obtain a sequence-verified GanA clone, the reporter did not give us a readout. Building it was harder than building the other cassettes since each reaction combined seven parts, including a CDS of roughly 2 kb and the added Csn and His tag, and repeated redesigns still failed to yield a correct clone. At the same time, the clones of our actual protectants were being sequence-verified without a reporter. The reporter strategy was therefore costing more time than it saved, and we concluded that we should test the protectants directly, using Western blot and ELISA to confirm their presence and secretion.

L學習

blocks.en: Testing of our ACCD in our bioreactor provided critical insight into both expression levels and circuit stability. Using the Csn:ACCD construct allowed us to directly monitor protectant production and evaluate secretion efficiency; however, constitutive runs through our bioreactor and a Western blot revealed that the overall protein yield was relatively low and did not reach optimal physiological levels. This highlighted the need for future optimization of expression elements, such as promoter strength or codon optimization, to boost output efficiency for demanding protectants.
blocks.text: Testing of our ACCD in our bioreactor provided critical insight into both expression levels and circuit stability. Using the Csn:ACCD construct allowed us to directly monitor protectant production and evaluate secretion efficiency; however, constitutive runs through our bioreactor and a Western blot revealed that the overall protein yield was relatively low and did not reach optimal physiological levels. This highlighted the need for future optimization of expression elements, such as promoter strength or codon optimization, to boost output efficiency for demanding protectants.
blocks.zh: 在生物反應器中測試 ACCD，給了我們關於表現量與迴路穩定性的關鍵資訊。使用 Csn:ACCD 構築讓我們能直接監測保護劑的生成並評估分泌效率；然而，通過生物反應器的組成型運轉與西方墨點法顯示，整體蛋白質產量相對偏低，並未達到理想的生理水準。這凸顯出未來需要最佳化表現元件，例如啟動子強度或密碼子最佳化，以提升要求較高的保護劑的輸出效率。

blocks.en: Furthermore, from an assembly perspective, although this cycle is mostly focused on the constitutive expression of ACCD, we were also working on our inducible system at the same time. Constructing multiple modules containing identical regulatory elements (Pveg, EEBD-RBS0, and B0015) highlighted an important concern. Reusing identical promoter and terminator sequences across all four modules of our full circuit created substantial sequence redundancy. When introduced into Bacillus subtilis, long stretches of sequence identity bring a high risk of triggering homologous recombination, which could destabilize or excise parts of our optogenetic circuit.
blocks.text: Furthermore, from an assembly perspective, although this cycle is mostly focused on the constitutive expression of ACCD, we were also working on our inducible system at the same time. Constructing multiple modules containing identical regulatory elements (Pveg, EEBD-RBS0, and B0015) highlighted an important concern. Reusing identical promoter and terminator sequences across all four modules of our full circuit created substantial sequence redundancy. When introduced into Bacillus subtilis, long stretches of sequence identity bring a high risk of triggering homologous recombination, which could destabilize or excise parts of our optogenetic circuit.
blocks.zh: 此外，從組裝的角度看，雖然這個循環主要集中在 ACCD 的組成型表現，我們同時也在做誘導型系統。建構多個含有相同調控元件（Pveg、EEBD-RBS0 與 B0015）的模組，凸顯出一個重要的顧慮。在完整迴路的四個模組中重複使用相同的啟動子與終止子序列，造成了相當大的序列冗餘。導入 Bacillus subtilis 之後，長段完全相同的序列有很高的風險觸發同源重組，可能使光遺傳迴路的部分不穩定或被切除。

blocks.en: To improve protein secretion, we redesigned the codons at the start of the SamyQ-fused secretion cassettes for BoPep4, LEA14, ACCD and AmilCP. Codon choice influences expression through translation initiation, which depends on how accessible the ribosome binding site and start codon are in the mRNA, and elongation, which depends on host codon usage. The first codons after the ATG can base-pair with the RBS region and occlude the Shine-Dalgarno (SD) sequence, so we defined start-region accessibility as the design objective and monitored codon adaptation to Bacillus subtilis as a constraint. Both aspects matter: the codon-optimized BoPep4 has a high codon adaptation index (CAI = 0.87) yet the lowest start-codon accessibility of all our constructs.
blocks.text: To improve protein secretion, we redesigned the codons at the start of the SamyQ-fused secretion cassettes for BoPep4, LEA14, ACCD and AmilCP. Codon choice influences expression through translation initiation, which depends on how accessible the ribosome binding site and start codon are in the mRNA, and elongation, which depends on host codon usage. The first codons after the ATG can base-pair with the RBS region and occlude the Shine-Dalgarno (SD) sequence, so we defined start-region accessibility as the design objective and monitored codon adaptation to Bacillus subtilis as a constraint. Both aspects matter: the codon-optimized BoPep4 has a high codon adaptation index (CAI = 0.87) yet the lowest start-codon accessibility of all our constructs.
blocks.zh: 為了改善蛋白質分泌，我們重新設計了 BoPep4、LEA14、ACCD 與 AmilCP 的 SamyQ 融合分泌卡匣起始處的密碼子。密碼子選擇透過兩條途徑影響表現：轉譯起始，取決於 mRNA 中核醣體結合位與起始密碼子的可及性；以及轉譯延長，取決於宿主的密碼子使用偏好。ATG 之後的前幾個密碼子可能與 RBS 區配對而遮蔽 Shine-Dalgarno（SD）序列，因此我們把起始區可及性定為設計目標，並把對 Bacillus subtilis 的密碼子適應度當作限制條件來監看。兩個面向都重要：密碼子最佳化後的 BoPep4 密碼子適應指數很高（CAI = 0.87），起始密碼子可及性卻是我們所有構築中最低的。

blocks.en: We modeled the 5′ end of each cassette with ViennaRNA 2.7.2 [8] at 37 °C. The folded region (Window A, 236 nt) comprised the B. subtilis dif recombination site (RS), MF001, a single A spacer placed between MF001 and the start codon, the SamyQ ORF (93 nt) and the first 90 nt of the CDS (143 nt for the Ho1 control). From the base-pair probabilities we calculated the mean unpaired probability over the SD core (AAGGAGG) and over the first 15 and 30 nt downstream of the start codon. We set start+15 ≈ 0.50 as the minimum acceptable value and used Ho1 (start+15 = 0.681) as a benchmark from a well-expressed gene.

blocks.zh: 我們以 ViennaRNA 2.7.2 [8] 在 37 °C 下模擬每個卡匣的 5′ 端。摺疊區（Window A，236 nt）包含 B. subtilis 的 dif 重組位（RS）、MF001、放在 MF001 與起始密碼子之間的單一 A 間隔、SamyQ 開放讀框（93 nt），以及 CDS 的前 90 nt（Ho1 對照為 143 nt）。我們從鹼基配對機率算出 SD 核心（AAGGAGG）以及起始密碼子下游前 15 與前 30 nt 的平均未配對機率。我們把 start+15 ≈ 0.50 設為可接受的最低值，並以 Ho1（start+15 = 0.681）作為一個高表現基因的基準。

blocks.en: We recoded codons synonymously, comparing two designs while leaving protein sequences unchanged. In the CDS-only design (v2), the first 15 codons of the protectant were editable and SamyQ was left untouched. In the SamyQ + CDS design (v3), SamyQ codons 2 to 31 (ATG locked) were also editable, giving 45 editable codons; the SamyQ cleavage site and both amino acid sequences were verified as unchanged. For each construct we drew about 50 000 random synonymous variants and folded each one, excluding any that introduced a BsaI, EcoRI, XbaI, SpeI, PstI, NotI or HindIII site on either strand within the recoded span plus 8 nt of flanking sequence. This left 33 000 to 41 000 unique legal variants per construct, ranked by a balance score (start+15 plus SD core).

blocks.zh: 我們以同義方式重新編碼密碼子，比較兩種設計，蛋白質序列維持不變。在只改 CDS 的設計（v2）中，保護劑的前 15 個密碼子可編輯，SamyQ 不動。在 SamyQ + CDS 的設計（v3）中，SamyQ 的第 2 到 31 個密碼子（ATG 鎖定）也可編輯，總共 45 個可編輯密碼子；SamyQ 的切割位與兩段胺基酸序列都經確認未改變。每個構築我們抽取約 50 000 個隨機同義變體並逐一摺疊，排除任何在重新編碼區段加上兩側 8 nt 範圍內、於任一股引入 BsaI、EcoRI、XbaI、SpeI、PstI、NotI 或 HindIII 位點的變體。這樣每個構築還剩 33 000 到 41 000 個不重複的合法變體，依平衡分數（start+15 加 SD 核心）排序。

blocks.en: Eight cassettes were ordered as synthetic DNA, each a full P<sub>cpcG2</sub>-veg → B0015 construct of 715 to 1657 nt differing from the wild-type cassette only by synonymous codon substitutions. BoPep4 and LEA14 use CDS-only designs, so they retain the validated SamyQ signal peptide; ACCD and AmilCP are each represented by both a CDS-only (v2) and a SamyQ + CDS (v3) design, which allows a direct test of whether editing the signal peptide improves or reduces expression and secretion.

blocks.en: Before wet-lab work, every reported candidate in the SamyQ-editable run (52 variants: the top 10, the wild type, the greedy control and the best-balance variant for each construct) was re-folded and re-checked for unchanged protein sequences and absence of the restriction sites listed above. All 52 variants passed. The best-balance variants increased start+15 by 1.3 to 1.9× and the SD core by 1.5 to 13× relative to wild type, and the predicted structures show the SD region becoming accessible in the optimized variants. The greedy low-GC control improved three of the four constructs but remained below the searched optimum, and for LEA14 it was worse than the wild type.

blocks.en: We initially designed the cassettes with MF001; however, we ran into difficulties when assembling them, so we changed to the STK EEBD-RBS0 part for the wet lab. After the change we recalculated the scores with RiboJ + RBS0 in place of MF001 and the A spacer. The SD core of the wild types was 0.301 to 0.496 behind RiboJ + RBS0, compared with 0.056 to 0.357 behind MF001 and the RS. Adding the RS changed the SD core by 0.441 on average with MF001, by 0.048 with the as-built inverted element, and by 0.009 with the published orientation.

L學習

blocks.en: Editing SamyQ in addition to the CDS opened the start region considerably more than editing the CDS alone, but at a cost in codon adaptation. For ACCD, start+15 increased from 0.563 (wild type) to 0.773 with the CDS-only design and to 0.860 with SamyQ + CDS, while CAI decreased from about 0.85 to 0.75 and then 0.59. AmilCP showed the same pattern. For BoPep4, CDS-only editing raised start+15 only from 0.396 to 0.497, still just below 0.50, although the SD core rose from 0.067 to 0.634.

blocks.zh: 除了 CDS 之外也編輯 SamyQ，把起始區打開的程度比只編輯 CDS 大得多，代價則是密碼子適應度。對 ACCD 來說，start+15 從 0.563（野生型）升到只改 CDS 的 0.773，再到 SamyQ + CDS 的 0.860，而 CAI 則從約 0.85 降到 0.75，再降到 0.59。AmilCP 呈現相同的樣式。對 BoPep4，只改 CDS 只讓 start+15 從 0.396 升到 0.497，仍略低於 0.50，不過 SD 核心從 0.067 升到 0.634。

blocks.en: The recalculation with RiboJ + RBS0 showed that recoding still helps a little in the context that we built, but less than we predicted with MF001. Most of the large gain came from removing the pairing between the RS and MF001, which RiboJ prevents. The balance score was higher than the wild type for six of the eight ordered variants, and the two BoPep4 variants were the exception. Ho1 also changed from start+15 = 0.681 to 0.613 with RiboJ + RBS0, so we compared designs by rank and no longer use 0.50 as a fixed cut-off.

blocks.zh: 以 RiboJ + RBS0 重新計算顯示，在我們實際建出的脈絡下，重新編碼仍有一些幫助，但比我們用 MF001 預測的少。大部分的大幅增益其實來自消除 RS 與 MF001 之間的配對，而 RiboJ 本身就會避免這種配對。八個訂購的變體中有六個平衡分數高於野生型，兩個 BoPep4 變體是例外。Ho1 在 RiboJ + RBS0 下也從 start+15 = 0.681 變成 0.613，因此我們改以排序比較設計，不再把 0.50 當作固定門檻。

blocks.en: There are limits to this analysis. ViennaRNA diagnoses only translation initiation, and only for the processed mRNA, so a higher start+15 identifies a construct worth testing and does not predict yield. It does not capture secretion efficiency, SRP targeting or co-translational export, degradation by extracytoplasmic HtrA and HtrB (particularly for disordered proteins such as LEA14), or uptake in the rhizosphere. Recoding SamyQ preserves the signal peptide sequence and its cleavage site, but whether the altered 5′ mRNA structure and elongation speed affect secretion is a hypothesis, which the ACCD and AmilCP v2/v3 comparison is designed to test.

blocks.en: Two limits of the pre-order checks should be stated. The restriction-site scan covered the recoded window only, so it does not certify the whole insert, and it did not include BpiI or BsmBI. Codon adaptation was recorded but not constrained in this run, and the ordered set spans CAI 0.59 to 0.81 against 0.85 to 0.87 for wild type, with the two SamyQ + CDS designs lowest. A homopolymer scan was recorded as a sequencing-slippage warning rather than a rejection criterion: three of the eight cassettes contain a 6-A run in the recoded span, and the fixed wild-type SamyQ already contains a 5-A run. Because we moved from MF001 to the STK EEBD-RBS0 part during assembly, the synthesized DNA still retains MF001 and both RS copies; only the recoded SamyQ and CDS region was carried forward, and it was assembled behind RiboJ + RBS0.

blocks.en: To improve the function of experimental wild-type protectants used in the constitutive expression vector, we designed a panel of mutant and truncated variants of BoPep4 and LEA14. All variants carried a C-terminal 6×His tag to enable detection and quantification by Western blot and ELISA.

All variants carried a C-terminal 6×His tag to enable detection and quantification by Western blot and ELISA.
blocks.zh: 為了改善組成型表現載體中所用的實驗野生型保護劑的功能，我們設計了一組 BoPep4 與 LEA14 的突變與截短變體。所有變體都帶 C 端 6×His 標籤，以便用西方墨點法與 ELISA 偵測與定量。

blocks.en: Following the first engineering domain of BoPep4, we designed point mutations at two residues in the peptide region: S15A and G17A. Literature predicts S15A to be about 100× weaker and G17A about 4000× weaker than the wild type [9]. These substitutions were not intended to improve the peptide. They were designed as reference controls for any future activity assay, chosen because the published AtPep1 literature already reports their effects. These loss-of-function variants act as a comparison for future activity tests, as a weak result from another variant can be judged against a documented loss-of-function peptide.

Literature predicts S15A to be about 100× weaker and G17A about 4000× weaker than the wild type [9]. These substitutions were not intended to improve the peptide. They were designed as reference controls for any future activity assay, chosen because the published AtPep1 literature already reports their effects. These loss-of-function variants act as a comparison for future activity tests, as a weak result from another variant can be judged against a documented loss-of-function peptide.
blocks.zh: 依照 BoPep4 的第一個工程領域，我們在胜肽區的兩個殘基上設計了點突變：S15A 與 G17A。文獻預測 S15A 比野生型弱約 100 倍，G17A 弱約 4000 倍 [9]。這些取代並不是為了改善胜肽，而是設計成未來任何活性檢測的參考對照；之所以選它們，是因為已發表的 AtPep1 文獻已經報告過它們的效果。這些功能喪失變體可以作為未來活性測試的比較基準，因為另一個變體若給出偏弱的結果，就能對照一個有文獻記載的功能喪失胜肽來判斷。

blocks.en: Truncations were our second engineering domain, focused on identifying the shortest fragment that retains receptor binding. After research and accounting for our goals, we chose the segments 7-23, 9-23 and 15-23 [10], which delete residues 1-6, 1-8 and 1-14 from the N-terminal side while maintaining the C-terminal region. By identifying the minimal active peptide, we can reasonably conclude an increase in secretion efficiency through the Sec pathway, allowing the peptides to travel faster from the bioreactor to the plant.

After research and accounting for our goals, we chose the segments 7-23, 9-23 and 15-23 [10], which delete residues 1-6, 1-8 and 1-14 from the N-terminal side while maintaining the C-terminal region. By identifying the minimal active peptide, we can reasonably conclude an increase in secretion efficiency through the Sec pathway, allowing the peptides to travel faster from the bioreactor to the plant.
blocks.zh: 截短是我們的第二個工程領域，重點在找出仍保有受體結合能力的最短片段。經過查閱文獻並考量我們的目標，我們選了 7-23、9-23 與 15-23 這幾段 [10]，分別從 N 端刪去殘基 1-6、1-8 與 1-14，同時保留 C 端區域。藉由找出最小的活性胜肽，我們可以合理推斷透過 Sec 路徑的分泌效率會提高，讓胜肽從生物反應器走到植物的速度更快。

blocks.en: For LEA14 we followed published literature, with the truncations intended to remove the disordered regions at the N-terminus, as the tethered ends are susceptible to proteolysis. We generated the truncations Δ1-23 and the shorter Δ1-16 to identify how much of the N-terminus is removable without loss of function. The Δ146-151 construct removes the last six residues, which are tethered and hydrophobic, a common starting point for aggregation. For fusion protein engineering, we incorporated a motif that mediates membrane binding by fusing a K-segment (EKKGIMDKIKEKLPG) from a maize dehydrin to the N-terminus of LEA14 through a flexible GGGGS linker, accounting for its inability to bind independently. We also fused the K-segment construct with the Δ1-6 truncation to test whether the two modifications would act additively.

The Δ146-151 construct removes the last six residues, which are tethered and hydrophobic, a common starting point for aggregation. For fusion protein engineering, we incorporated a motif that mediates membrane binding by fusing a K-segment (EKKGIMDKIKEKLPG) from a maize dehydrin to the N-terminus of LEA14 through a flexible GGGGS linker, accounting for its inability to bind independently. We also fused the K-segment construct with the Δ1-6 truncation to test whether the two modifications would act additively.
blocks.zh: LEA14 方面我們依照已發表的文獻，截短的目的是移除 N 端的無序區，因為繫在末端的部分容易被蛋白酶水解。我們做了 Δ1-23 以及更短的 Δ1-16 兩種截短，以判斷 N 端可以移除多少而不損失功能。Δ146-151 構築移除最後六個殘基，這些殘基繫在末端且具疏水性，是常見的聚集起點。在融合蛋白工程方面，我們以彈性的 GGGGS 連接子，把玉米脫水素的一段 K 區段（EKKGIMDKIKEKLPG）融合到 LEA14 的 N 端，加入一個介導膜結合的模組，因為 LEA14 本身無法獨立結合。我們也把 K 區段構築與 Δ1-6 截短合併，測試兩種修改是否會有加成效果。

T測試

blocks.en: We screened transformant colonies by colony PCR with Q-Amp master mix. For the Level 1 and Level 2 constructs the expected products are 678 bp (EXP fw and BoPep4 R) and 632 bp (L2 CcaSm3 F and L2 CcaR R). Cycling was 95 °C for 5 min, then 35 cycles of 95 °C for 20 s, 60 °C for 20 s and 72 °C for a time matched to amplicon size, then 72 °C for 5 min. Products were run on agarose gels beside a DNA ladder. Colonies giving a single band at the expected size were grown overnight, miniprepped and sent for sequencing with the pEXP and pSTK sequencing primers. Sequence-verified plasmids were electroporated into Bacillus subtilis WB800 and re-screened by colony PCR.

We also cultured the cells in the bioreactor, collecting cell lysate and culture medium from the lumen and shell sides at each time point for the same three assays.
blocks.text: To test function we grew verified transformant colonies, ACC deaminase in WB800, on a large scale and collected the supernatant, and prepared those samples for Western blot, ELISA and the DNPH assay. We also cultured the cells in the bioreactor, collecting cell lysate and culture medium from the lumen and shell sides at each time point for the same three assays.
blocks.zh: 為了測試功能，我們把經確認的轉形菌落（WB800 中的 ACC 去胺酶）大規模培養並收集上清液，把這些樣品準備好做西方墨點法、ELISA 與 DNPH 檢測。我們也把細胞養在生物反應器中，在每個時間點從管腔側與殼側收集細胞裂解液與培養液，做同樣的三項檢測。

blocks.en: The DNPH assay first settled whether the secreted enzyme needs its cofactor, pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP), by running wild-type AcdS and the codon-optimized AcdS 2.1 supernatants with and without added PLP. Activity was higher in the supplemented reactions, so PLP is limiting under our assay conditions and every later assay carries it. ELISA across the three cargoes put ACC deaminase at the highest supernatant concentration, with LEA14 and BoPep4 2.1 both lower. Comparing wild type against codon-optimized at 8 and 12 hours, optimized ACC deaminase came out below its own wild type, while BoPep4 2.2 came out above its wild type at both times — secretion from the recoded cassettes was comparable to, not substantially higher than, the wild types, which is what we would expect of optimizations designed against MF001 and then built behind RiboJ + RBS0.

blocks.zh: DNPH 檢測先解決了分泌出來的酵素是否需要其輔因子吡哆醛 5′-磷酸（PLP）這件事：把野生型 AcdS 與密碼子最佳化的 AcdS 2.1 上清液在有加與沒加 PLP 的條件下各跑一次。有補充的反應活性較高，因此在我們的檢測條件下 PLP 是限制因子，後續每一次檢測都加入它。三種載荷的 ELISA 顯示 ACC 去胺酶的上清液濃度最高，LEA14 與 BoPep4 2.1 都較低。在 8 與 12 小時比較野生型與密碼子最佳化版本時，最佳化的 ACC 去胺酶低於自己的野生型，而 BoPep4 2.2 在兩個時間點都高於自己的野生型；重新編碼卡匣的分泌量與野生型相當，並沒有明顯更高，而這正是我們對「針對 MF001 設計、卻建在 RiboJ + RBS0 之後」的最佳化所預期的結果。

L學習

blocks.en: The side-by-side ELISA says ACC deaminase is secreted at a higher concentration than either LEA14 or BoPep4 2.1, and that recoding moved the two cargoes in opposite directions: optimized ACC deaminase below its wild type at both time points, BoPep4 2.2 above its wild type at both. The reactor pair says something the bench pair cannot. Protein in the shell permeate peaks at twelve hours and activity at eighteen; since the ELISA detects the His tag whether or not the enzyme is folded, part of the ACC deaminase crossing the membrane arrives inactive and matures afterwards.

blocks.zh: 並列的 ELISA 說 ACC 去胺酶的分泌濃度高於 LEA14 或 BoPep4 2.1，也說重新編碼讓兩種載荷往相反方向移動：最佳化的 ACC 去胺酶在兩個時間點都低於自己的野生型，BoPep4 2.2 在兩個時間點都高於自己的野生型。反應器那一對數據說出了桌上那一對說不出來的事。殼側滲透液中的蛋白質在十二小時達到高峰，活性在十八小時；由於 ELISA 偵測的是 His 標籤，不論酵素是否摺疊都會被測到，因此有一部分穿過薄膜的 ACC 去胺酶抵達時並沒有活性，之後才成熟。

blocks.en: The panel is designed so that a future activity assay has a known loss-of-function control to read against, which is the part of this cycle that will outlast the season. What the panel does not yet have is the assay. The remaining work is to run each variant under dark and red or green light, collect cell lysate and culture medium from the lumen and medium from the shell at each time point, and run anti-His Western blots to measure expression, secretion and diffusion, then compare each protectant against its constitutive version. The activity assays that would rank the truncations against S15A and G17A are not among the results we have.

blocks.zh: 這組面板的設計，是讓未來的活性檢測有一個已知的功能喪失對照可以對照著讀，這也是這個循環會留存超過這一季的部分。面板目前還缺的就是那個檢測。剩下的工作是把每個變體在黑暗以及紅光或綠光下各跑一次，在每個時間點從管腔側收集細胞裂解液與培養液、從殼側收集培養液，並做抗 His 的西方墨點法來量測表現、分泌與擴散，再把每一種保護劑與它的組成型版本比較。那些能把截短與 S15A、G17A 放在一起排序的活性檢測，並不在我們現有的結果裡。

進入 Bacillus subtilis

blocks.en: Neither of the other two pipelines produces anything until its plasmid is inside a Gram-positive cell, and standard transformation in B. subtilis varies too much between strains to rely on. Two cycles worked out electroporation conditions, one per strain, and the second is the reason the project changed host. The read-out is colonies recovered, counted plate by plate; the full set of counts is on Results.

D設計

blocks.en: To engineer Bacillus subtilis to produce and secrete bioprotectants, the plasmid constructs carrying those sequences have to get into the host cells. Electroporation applies a high-voltage pulse across the cell membrane, forming the transient pores a plasmid needs to enter. While standard transformation methods in Bacillus subtilis can be significantly constrained by strain variability in efficiency, electroporation provides a more controllable, high-efficiency technique critical for expressing recombinant stress-mitigating proteins [15].
blocks.text: To engineer Bacillus subtilis to produce and secrete bioprotectants, the plasmid constructs carrying those sequences have to get into the host cells. Electroporation applies a high-voltage pulse across the cell membrane, forming the transient pores a plasmid needs to enter. While standard transformation methods in Bacillus subtilis can be significantly constrained by strain variability in efficiency, electroporation provides a more controllable, high-efficiency technique critical for expressing recombinant stress-mitigating proteins [15].
blocks.zh: 要把 Bacillus subtilis 改造成能生產並分泌生物保護劑，帶有這些序列的質體構築必須先進到宿主細胞裡。電穿孔在細胞膜上施加高壓脈衝，形成質體進入所需的短暫孔洞。Bacillus subtilis 的標準轉形方法在效率上會受到菌株差異的明顯限制，而電穿孔提供一種更可控、高效率的技術，對表現重組的逆境緩解蛋白質而言十分關鍵 [15]。

blocks.en: The first design focused on introducing the construct Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-SamyQ-ACCD-v2t1-B0015 into Bacillus subtilis 168 through electroporation. The experiment aimed to evaluate whether the plasmid could be introduced successfully and determine which electroporation voltage produced the greatest number of bacterial colonies. Two voltages, 2.1 kV and 2.3 kV, were selected for testing in 2 mm gap cuvettes, with the resistance maintained at 300 Ω and the capacitance at 25 µF.

The experiment aimed to evaluate whether the plasmid could be introduced successfully and determine which electroporation voltage produced the greatest number of bacterial colonies. Two voltages, 2.1 kV and 2.3 kV, were selected for testing in 2 mm gap cuvettes, with the resistance maintained at 300 Ω and the capacitance at 25 µF.
blocks.zh: 第一個設計的重點是透過電穿孔，把構築 Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-SamyQ-ACCD-v2t1-B0015 導入 Bacillus subtilis 168。這個實驗想評估質體能否成功導入，並判斷哪一種電穿孔電壓能得到最多的菌落。我們在 2 mm 間隙的電穿孔槽中測試兩種電壓，2.1 kV 與 2.3 kV，電阻維持在 300 Ω，電容維持在 25 µF。
B建構

blocks.en: Electrocompetent Bacillus subtilis 168 cells were prepared following the protocol from the DTU-Denmark iGEM team [14]: the overnight culture was diluted 16-fold and grown at 37 °C and 200 rpm to OD600 0.85 to 0.95, cooled on ice for 5 minutes, centrifuged at 5000 × g for 10 minutes, washed twice with ice-cold electroporation buffer and resuspended in one twentieth of the original culture volume. Aliquots were stored at −80 °C.
blocks.text: Electrocompetent Bacillus subtilis 168 cells were prepared following the protocol from the DTU-Denmark iGEM team [14]: the overnight culture was diluted 16-fold and grown at 37 °C and 200 rpm to OD600 0.85 to 0.95, cooled on ice for 5 minutes, centrifuged at 5000 × g for 10 minutes, washed twice with ice-cold electroporation buffer and resuspended in one twentieth of the original culture volume. Aliquots were stored at −80 °C.
blocks.zh: 電穿孔勝任的 Bacillus subtilis 168 細胞依 DTU-Denmark iGEM 團隊的流程製備 [14]：隔夜培養物稀釋 16 倍，在 37 °C、200 rpm 下培養到 OD600 0.85 至 0.95，在冰上冷卻 5 分鐘，以 5000 × g 離心 10 分鐘，用冰冷的電穿孔緩衝液洗兩次，再以原培養體積的二十分之一重新懸浮。分裝後保存於 −80 °C。

blocks.en: For the pulse, plasmid DNA was mixed with 100 µL of electrocompetent cells and transferred to a pre-chilled 0.2 cm cuvette. The Gene Pulser Xcell was set to two voltage conditions, 2.1 and 2.3 kV, with resistance and capacitance held at 300 Ω and 25 µF. After the pulse, 2 mL of prewarmed SOC recovery medium was added immediately, the cells were recovered for 3 hours at 37 °C and 200 rpm, then plated on LB agar containing 5 µg/mL erythromycin and incubated overnight at 37 °C.

The Gene Pulser Xcell was set to two voltage conditions, 2.1 and 2.3 kV, with resistance and capacitance held at 300 Ω and 25 µF. After the pulse, 2 mL of prewarmed SOC recovery medium was added immediately, the cells were recovered for 3 hours at 37 °C and 200 rpm, then plated on LB agar containing 5 µg/mL erythromycin and incubated overnight at 37 °C.
blocks.zh: 施加脈衝時，質體 DNA 與 100 µL 電穿孔勝任細胞混合，移入預冷的 0.2 cm 電穿孔槽。Gene Pulser Xcell 設定為兩種電壓條件，2.1 與 2.3 kV，電阻與電容固定在 300 Ω 與 25 µF。脈衝後立即加入 2 mL 預溫的 SOC 回復培養基，細胞在 37 °C、200 rpm 下回復 3 小時，再塗在含 5 µg/mL 紅黴素的 LB 瓊脂上，於 37 °C 隔夜培養。
T測試

blocks.en: Colonies were counted on each plate to compare transformation efficiency across the electroporation conditions. Transformants were plated on erythromycin-supplemented LB agar so that the pulse voltage could be read against both cell viability and transformation frequency. 2.1 kV gave 21 distinct colonies; raising the pulse to 2.3 kV cut recovery to about 8, which we read as field-induced cell death.
blocks.text: Colonies were counted on each plate to compare transformation efficiency across the electroporation conditions. Transformants were plated on erythromycin-supplemented LB agar so that the pulse voltage could be read against both cell viability and transformation frequency. 2.1 kV gave 21 distinct colonies; raising the pulse to 2.3 kV cut recovery to about 8, which we read as field-induced cell death.
blocks.zh: 我們數了每一盤的菌落，比較不同電穿孔條件的轉形效率。轉形株塗在含紅黴素的 LB 瓊脂上，使脈衝電壓能同時對照細胞存活率與轉形頻率來讀。2.1 kV 得到 21 個清楚的菌落；把脈衝提高到 2.3 kV 時，回收數降到約 8 個，我們把這解讀為電場造成的細胞死亡。
L學習

blocks.en: Transformation yield fell as field strength rose. 2.1 kV yielded 21 colonies, while 2.3 kV dropped sharply to 8. Higher voltages do permeabilise the membrane more, but at 2.3 kV the field strength most likely caused excessive cell lysis and irreversible membrane damage, compromising post-pulse viability. At the fixed 300 Ω and 25 µF, 2.1 kV balances pore formation against survival better, so we standardized the protocol at 2.1 kV.
blocks.text: Transformation yield fell as field strength rose. 2.1 kV yielded 21 colonies, while 2.3 kV dropped sharply to 8. Higher voltages do permeabilise the membrane more, but at 2.3 kV the field strength most likely caused excessive cell lysis and irreversible membrane damage, compromising post-pulse viability. At the fixed 300 Ω and 25 µF, 2.1 kV balances pore formation against survival better, so we standardized the protocol at 2.1 kV.
blocks.zh: 轉形產量隨電場強度上升而下降。2.1 kV 得到 21 個菌落，而 2.3 kV 大幅掉到 8 個。較高的電壓確實讓細胞膜通透性更高，但在 2.3 kV 下，電場強度很可能造成過度的細胞破裂與不可逆的膜損傷，損害脈衝後的存活率。在固定的 300 Ω 與 25 µF 下，2.1 kV 在孔洞形成與存活之間取得較好的平衡，因此我們把流程標準化在 2.1 kV。

blocks.en: What the colony counts cannot say is whether the recovered colonies carried the intended construct: no colony PCR is on record for this run.

blocks.zh: 菌落數說不出來的是，回收到的菌落是否帶有預期的構築：這一次運轉沒有菌落 PCR 的紀錄。

blocks.en: The WB800 experiments investigated the introduction of several plasmid constructs into Bacillus subtilis WB800. The recorded constructs were Pveg-SamyQ:AcdS 2.1, Pveg-SamyQ:AcdS 2.2, pSTK-EXP2-CcaSRv1-AcdS 2.1, Pveg-BoPep4_15-23 and Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-SamyQ:BoPep4-2.1-Histag-B0015. For the main WB800 electroporations we used 2.1, 2.3 and 2.5 kV in a 0.2 cm cuvette, with the resistance set to 250 Ω and the capacitance to 25 µF. The resistance was reduced from 300 Ω to 250 Ω to shorten the pulse time constant and so reduce post-pulse cell death. The BoPep4 constructs were tested separately using a 0.1 cm cuvette at 1.1 and 1.5 kV, which is 11 and 15 kV/cm. These experiments allowed colony recovery to be compared across different constructs and electroporation conditions.

blocks.en: Electrocompetent WB800 cells were prepared following the protocol described by Lu and colleagues [13], which differs from the 168 preparation in three places: the culture is grown to OD<sub>600</sub> 2.2 instead of 0.85 to 0.95, the pellet is washed four times with ice-cold electroporation buffer containing 1.5 mol/L trehalose instead of twice with plain buffer, and the cells are resuspended in one fortieth of the original culture volume instead of one twentieth. The pulse, the 3-hour recovery in SOC and the selective plating are the same as for 168.

blocks.zh: 電穿孔勝任的 WB800 細胞依 Lu 等人所述的流程製備 [13]，與 168 的製備有三處不同：培養到 OD<sub>600</sub> 2.2 而不是 0.85 至 0.95；菌體沉澱以含 1.5 mol/L 海藻糖的冰冷電穿孔緩衝液洗四次，而不是以純緩衝液洗兩次；細胞以原培養體積的四十分之一重新懸浮，而不是二十分之一。脈衝、在 SOC 中回復 3 小時與選擇性塗盤都與 168 相同。

L學習

blocks.en: We tested the 168 protocol on WB800 and it did not succeed, so we used the protocol published for WB800 instead. B. subtilis 168 is the standard wild-type laboratory strain, whereas WB800 is a 168 derivative engineered for secreted protein production by deleting eight extracellular proteases (nprE, aprE, epr, bpr, mpr, nprB, vpr, wprA) [12]. These deletions, including the cell-wall-associated protease WprA, may compromise cell envelope integrity and alter the strain’s growth physiology, so WB800 tolerates the physical stresses of cryopreservation and high-voltage electroporation less well than 168. That structural vulnerability explains why the protocol tailored for 168, harvesting at OD600 0.85 to 0.95 with two washes in plain EP buffer and 20× concentration, gave poor viability for WB800, and why high-density growth to OD600 2.2, a hyperosmotic wash in 1.5 mol/L trehalose and the lowered resistance are what stabilize the WB800 membrane and preserve the cells.

These deletions, including the cell-wall-associated protease WprA, may compromise cell envelope integrity and alter the strain’s growth physiology, so WB800 tolerates the physical stresses of cryopreservation and high-voltage electroporation less well than 168. That structural vulnerability explains why the protocol tailored for 168, harvesting at OD600 0.85 to 0.95 with two washes in plain EP buffer and 20× concentration, gave poor viability for WB800, and why high-density growth to OD600 2.2, a hyperosmotic wash in 1.5 mol/L trehalose and the lowered resistance are what stabilize the WB800 membrane and preserve the cells.
blocks.zh: 我們把 168 的流程用在 WB800 上，並沒有成功，因此改用為 WB800 發表的流程。B. subtilis 168 是標準的野生型實驗室菌株，而 WB800 是 168 的衍生株，為了生產分泌蛋白質而刪除了八個胞外蛋白酶（nprE、aprE、epr、bpr、mpr、nprB、vpr、wprA）[12]。這些刪除，包括與細胞壁相關的蛋白酶 WprA，可能損害細胞外被的完整性並改變菌株的生長生理，因此 WB800 對冷凍保存與高壓電穿孔的物理壓力，耐受性不如 168。這種結構上的脆弱說明了為什麼為 168 量身訂做的流程（在 OD600 0.85 至 0.95 收菌、以純 EP 緩衝液洗兩次、濃縮 20 倍）會讓 WB800 存活率不佳，也說明了為什麼高密度培養到 OD600 2.2、以 1.5 mol/L 海藻糖做高滲洗滌、以及降低電阻，才是穩定 WB800 細胞膜並保住細胞的做法。

blocks.en: Colony counts dropped at higher voltages, which suggests that excessive field strength causes cell lysis and sets a limit for these strains. The optimum is not one number: it moved from 2.1 kV to 2.3 kV between two constructs in the same strain and the same cuvette, and down to 1.1 kV once the cuvette gap halved.

blocks.en: Strain-specific electrocompetent cell protocols. We established preparation workflows for B. subtilis 168 and WB800 that differ in the OD600 at harvest, the washing buffer and the resuspension volume. Optimized electroporation voltages for each strain, compared at fixed resistance and capacitance. Evidence of how voltage affects cell viability, since colony counts drop at higher voltages, which sets a practical limit and saves another team cells and plasmid. Demonstrated electroporation of multiple constructs, including the 10 kb CcaSR light sensor plasmid, which shows the protocol works across different plasmids and selection markers. The step-by-step procedure, covering cell preparation, the pulse, a 3-hour recovery, selective plating and colony counting, is on Experiments.

We established preparation workflows for B. subtilis 168 and WB800 that differ in the OD600 at harvest, the washing buffer and the resuspension volume. The step-by-step procedure, covering cell preparation, the pulse, a 3-hour recovery, selective plating and colony counting, is on Experiments.
blocks.zh: 菌株專屬的電穿孔勝任細胞流程。我們為 B. subtilis 168 與 WB800 建立了製備流程，兩者在收菌時的 OD600、洗滌緩衝液與重新懸浮體積上都不同。各菌株的最佳電穿孔電壓，在固定電阻與電容下比較。關於電壓如何影響細胞存活率的證據：菌落數在較高電壓下下降，這設下一個實用上限，也替其他團隊省下細胞與質體。多個構築的電穿孔示範，包括 10 kb 的 CcaSR 光感測質體，顯示這套流程在不同質體與選擇標記上都行得通。逐步的操作程序，涵蓋細胞製備、脈衝、3 小時回復、選擇性塗盤與菌落計數，放在實驗頁。
生物反應器

blocks.en: A hollow-fiber loop that keeps engineered cells on one side of a membrane and lets the protectant across. Eight cycles, from a loop that leaked at the pump head to four integrated runs on cells, the last of them holding a culture of Bacillus subtilis WB800 for seventy-seven hours with the loop correcting its own pH. The first three integrated runs were each ended early by a different failure; the fourth ran to a complete growth curve. What they produced between them is a strain that secretes detectable protectant, a hydraulic loop that reads reliably, a sterilization procedure we had to break something to get right, automated pH control, and a harvest that can be asked for: closing one valve lifts the pressure across the membrane and the permeate comes out. The reactor record sorts the same work into three tracks across three prototypes, and cycles 5 to 8 here are its integrated runs. The machine those cycles converge on is specified end to end in the user manual and built stage by stage in the assembly guide, and where those documents and an older cycle disagree on a number, the cycle below says which one the machine has.

blocks.zh: 一個中空纖維迴路，把改造後的細胞留在薄膜的一側，讓保護劑穿過去。八個循環，從一個在幫浦頭漏液的迴路，到四次用細胞跑的整合運轉，其中最後一次讓 Bacillus subtilis WB800 的培養維持了七十七小時，由迴路自行校正 pH。前三次整合運轉各自因為不同的故障提早結束；第四次跑出完整的生長曲線。它們合起來產出的是：一株會分泌可偵測保護劑的菌、一個讀值可靠的水力迴路、一套我們得先弄壞東西才做對的滅菌程序、自動 pH 控制，以及一個可以主動要求的收取方式：關上一個閥，薄膜兩側的壓差就升高，滲透液隨之流出。反應器紀錄把同樣的工作依三個原型分成三條軌線，而這裡的循環 5 到 8 就是它的整合運轉。這些循環最後收斂到的那台機器，在使用手冊中從頭到尾規格化，並在組裝指南中一步一步建起來；當這些文件與較早的循環在某個數字上不一致時，下面的循環會說出機器實際上是哪一個。

D設計

blocks.en: Initially, the objective of our design was to establish a functional continuous flow system utilizing a PES hollow fiber membrane. This preliminary build provided initial insights into structural limitations and potential hardware optimizations. The design of our Bioreactor comprises a PES Hollow Fiber Membrane, medium reservoir, Peristaltic pump, and luer valve, offering a simple, continuous flow-through mechanism.
