blocks.zh: 我們最初的設計目標，是建立一個使用 PES 中空纖維薄膜的可運作連續流系統。這個初步建構讓我們初步看到結構上的限制，以及硬體可以最佳化的地方。我們生物反應器的設計包含一片 PES 中空纖維薄膜、培養液儲液槽、蠕動幫浦與 luer 閥，提供一個簡單的連續流通機制。
B建構

blocks.en: Within this first cycle, we utilized a PES hollow fiber protein membrane (lumen volume: ~200 mL) connected to a 500 mL LB medium reservoir containing 300 mL of LB medium, inoculated with 20 mL of a multi-overnight Bacillus subtilis liquid culture.
blocks.text: Within this first cycle, we utilized a PES hollow fiber protein membrane (lumen volume: ~200 mL) connected to a 500 mL LB medium reservoir containing 300 mL of LB medium, inoculated with 20 mL of a multi-overnight Bacillus subtilis liquid culture.
blocks.zh: 在第一個循環中，我們用了一片 PES 中空纖維蛋白質薄膜（管腔體積約 200 mL），接到一個 500 mL 的 LB 培養液儲液槽，槽內裝 300 mL LB 培養液，並以 20 mL 多次隔夜培養的 Bacillus subtilis 液體培養物接種。
T測試

blocks.en: Within early phase testing, the peristaltic pump achieved the target flow rate of 94 mL/min; however, the trial was prematurely terminated due to localized medium leakage within the peristaltic pump. We then evaluated microbial viability, yielding final OD600 readings of 0.304 (in-tube) and 0.48 (medium reservoir).
blocks.text: Within early phase testing, the peristaltic pump achieved the target flow rate of 94 mL/min; however, the trial was prematurely terminated due to localized medium leakage within the peristaltic pump. We then evaluated microbial viability, yielding final OD600 readings of 0.304 (in-tube) and 0.48 (medium reservoir).
blocks.zh: 在早期階段的測試中，蠕動幫浦達到了 94 mL/min 的目標流量；然而這次試驗因為蠕動幫浦內出現局部培養液滲漏而提早終止。我們接著評估微生物存活情形，最終 OD600 讀值為 0.304（管內）與 0.48（培養液儲液槽）。
L學習

blocks.en: The divergent OD600 values between the tube and reservoir indicated poor microbial viability and pointed to two key hardware limitations for the next DBTL cycle. Exhibiting these factors, we hypothesize that the lack of active mixing led to nutrient stratification and cell sedimentation within the reservoir, limiting growth.
blocks.text: The divergent OD600 values between the tube and reservoir indicated poor microbial viability and pointed to two key hardware limitations for the next DBTL cycle. Exhibiting these factors, we hypothesize that the lack of active mixing led to nutrient stratification and cell sedimentation within the reservoir, limiting growth.
blocks.zh: 管內與儲液槽之間 OD600 值的分歧顯示微生物存活不佳，也指出下一個 DBTL 循環要處理的兩個關鍵硬體限制。從這些因素來看，我們推測缺少主動混合導致儲液槽內養分分層與細胞沉降，限制了生長。

blocks.en: Prototype I as drawn by the team on 6 June 2026: four parts, no stirring, no aeration, no pH control.
blocks.text: Prototype I as drawn by the team on 6 June 2026: four parts, no stirring, no aeration, no pH control.
blocks.zh: 團隊在 2026 年 6 月 6 日所畫的原型 I：四個部件，沒有攪拌、沒有通氣、沒有 pH 控制。

blocks.en: The reason the next cycle happened. Over twenty-seven hours at room temperature the flask passes OD600 2.4 and the reactor never leaves 0.3.
blocks.text: The reason the next cycle happened. Over twenty-seven hours at room temperature the flask passes OD600 2.4 and the reactor never leaves 0.3.
blocks.zh: 下一個循環之所以發生的原因。在室溫下的二十七小時裡，燒瓶越過 OD600 2.4，而反應器始終沒有離開 0.3。

blocks.en: Show details The containment plate, and the three changes this cycle asked for.
blocks.text: Show details The containment plate, and the three changes this cycle asked for.
blocks.zh: 顯示細節 圍阻培養盤，以及這個循環要求的三項改動。

blocks.en: To confirm the microbial presence and viability, 2 mL of the medium was extracted from the Shell side of the Hollow fiber membrane and was plated on LB agar to examine colony formation. From this, we observed the absence of colony formation, providing functional proof that our bioreactor is bio-safe for public agricultural usage.
blocks.text: To confirm the microbial presence and viability, 2 mL of the medium was extracted from the Shell side of the Hollow fiber membrane and was plated on LB agar to examine colony formation. From this, we observed the absence of colony formation, providing functional proof that our bioreactor is bio-safe for public agricultural usage.
blocks.zh: 為了確認微生物的存在與存活，我們從中空纖維薄膜的殼側取出 2 mL 培養液，塗在 LB 瓊脂上觀察菌落形成。由此我們觀察到沒有菌落形成，提供了我們的生物反應器對公共農業使用而言是生物安全的功能性證明。

blocks.en: The shell-side plate from prototype I, with no colony formation. It is the evidence behind the only containment claim this project makes, and it is one plating from one run. The pore size argument behind it, a 0.2 µm membrane against cells of 0.25 to 1.0 µm, is on Hardware.
blocks.text: The shell-side plate from prototype I, with no colony formation. It is the evidence behind the only containment claim this project makes, and it is one plating from one run. The pore size argument behind it, a 0.2 µm membrane against cells of 0.25 to 1.0 µm, is on Hardware.
blocks.zh: 原型 I 的殼側培養盤，沒有菌落形成。這是本計畫唯一一項圍阻主張背後的證據，而它是一次運轉中的一次塗盤。其背後的孔徑論證，0.2 µm 的薄膜對 0.25 到 1.0 µm 的細胞，放在硬體頁。

blocks.en: Furthermore, to overcome the observed lack of microbial growth, we plan to incorporate an active magnetic stirring mechanism, inspired by the Biology laboratory Hot plate magnetic stirrer, to prevent sedimentation and ensure a homogeneous nutrient distribution. In addition, to improve the data collection accuracy and minimize contamination risks, we plan to relocate our initial sampling ports directly to the medium reservoir’s outlet within our next DBTL cycle.
blocks.text: Furthermore, to overcome the observed lack of microbial growth, we plan to incorporate an active magnetic stirring mechanism, inspired by the Biology laboratory Hot plate magnetic stirrer, to prevent sedimentation and ensure a homogeneous nutrient distribution. In addition, to improve the data collection accuracy and minimize contamination risks, we plan to relocate our initial sampling ports directly to the medium reservoir’s outlet within our next DBTL cycle.
blocks.zh: 此外，為了克服觀察到的微生物生長不足，我們計畫加入主動磁攪拌機制，靈感來自生物實驗室的加熱磁攪拌器，以防止沉降並確保養分分布均勻。另外，為了提高數據收集的準確度並降低汙染風險，我們計畫在下一個 DBTL 循環把原本的取樣口直接移到培養液儲液槽的出口。

blocks.en: In order to address the mechanical leakage, we identified the need for biocompatible tubing (BPT) to ensure higher durability and more stable sealing between transition points of the pump.
blocks.text: In order to address the mechanical leakage, we identified the need for biocompatible tubing (BPT) to ensure higher durability and more stable sealing between transition points of the pump.
blocks.zh: 為了處理機械性漏液，我們認定需要生物相容管材（BPT），以確保更高的耐用度，並讓幫浦各轉接點之間的密封更穩定。

blocks.en: What that plate can support is narrower than the sentence above it. No replicate count was stated for it, and its incubation time and temperature were not recorded. The reactor record now counts two platings in all, the second run beside a lumen-side plate that grew, which is what makes an empty plate mean anything; it states no replicate count either. The barrier is also the only containment stage in the loop, and the 0.2 µm pore that holds cells back passes vesicles and cell debris.
blocks.text: What that plate can support is narrower than the sentence above it. No replicate count was stated for it, and its incubation time and temperature were not recorded. The reactor record now counts two platings in all, the second run beside a lumen-side plate that grew, which is what makes an empty plate mean anything; it states no replicate count either. The barrier is also the only containment stage in the loop, and the 0.2 µm pore that holds cells back passes vesicles and cell debris.
blocks.zh: 那一盤能支持的，比它上面那句話窄得多。它沒有說明重複次數，培養時間與溫度也沒有記錄。反應器紀錄現在總共只算兩次塗盤，第二次旁邊還有一盤長出東西的管腔側培養盤，而這才讓一盤空的培養盤具有意義；那份紀錄同樣沒有說明重複次數。這道屏障也是迴路中唯一的圍阻環節，而擋住細胞的 0.2 µm 孔徑仍會讓囊泡與細胞碎片通過。

blocks.en: The plate is a standing procedure now, no longer a result. The user manual asks for the shell side to be plated on the first run after every membrane change, and after any run in which the pressure trend changes, and for the harvested fluid to be treated as live culture until that plate has grown nothing. It says in as many words that the membrane separates by size and not by molecule: everything under the pore crosses, the product with it. Containment is the state of the module, the tubing, the connectors and the pump head around it, and it is re-established at each module change; June proved it once, for one module.
blocks.text: The plate is a standing procedure now, no longer a result. The user manual asks for the shell side to be plated on the first run after every membrane change, and after any run in which the pressure trend changes, and for the harvested fluid to be treated as live culture until that plate has grown nothing. It says in as many words that the membrane separates by size and not by molecule: everything under the pore crosses, the product with it. Containment is the state of the module, the tubing, the connectors and the pump head around it, and it is re-established at each module change; June proved it once, for one module.
blocks.zh: 這一盤現在是一道常設程序，不再是結果。使用手冊要求每次換膜後的第一次運轉都要做殼側塗盤，任何壓力趨勢改變的運轉之後也要做，並要求在那盤什麼都沒長出來之前，把收取到的液體當作活菌培養物處理。手冊明白寫著薄膜是依大小而非依分子分離：孔徑以下的一切都會穿過，產物也在其中。圍阻是模組、管材、接頭與周邊幫浦頭整體的狀態，每次更換模組都要重新建立；六月那次只證明過一次，而且只針對一個模組。

blocks.en: Stirring, 37 °C and a sampling port at the reservoir gave the first complete growth curve
blocks.text: Stirring, 37 °C and a sampling port at the reservoir gave the first complete growth curve
blocks.zh: 攪拌、37 °C 與裝在儲液槽的取樣口，給出第一條完整的生長曲線
結果

blocks.en: The reactor plateaued at OD600 0.8 to 0.9 after about two hours, against the flask’s 0.6 to 0.8 after four and a half.
blocks.text: The reactor plateaued at OD600 0.8 to 0.9 after about two hours, against the flask’s 0.6 to 0.8 after four and a half.
blocks.zh: 反應器在約兩小時後於 OD600 0.8 至 0.9 進入平台期，燒瓶則在四小時半後落在 0.6 至 0.8。
下一步改動

blocks.en: Run it again at 22 °C, on higher-durability BPT tubing.
blocks.text: Run it again at 22 °C, on higher-durability BPT tubing.
blocks.zh: 在 22 °C 下、換上更耐用的 BPT 管材再跑一次。
D設計

blocks.en: Improving on the previous design, a 200rpm magnetic stir was added to the medium reservoir to prevent sedimentation and ensure a homogeneous nutrient distribution. In addition, the sampling sector was placed closer to the medium reservoir to acquire a more accurate measurement as the reservoir contains much more relative volume compared to the hollow fiber membrane, giving us a more averaged prediction of the total OD of the entire bioreactor module.
blocks.text: Improving on the previous design, a 200rpm magnetic stir was added to the medium reservoir to prevent sedimentation and ensure a homogeneous nutrient distribution. In addition, the sampling sector was placed closer to the medium reservoir to acquire a more accurate measurement as the reservoir contains much more relative volume compared to the hollow fiber membrane, giving us a more averaged prediction of the total OD of the entire bioreactor module.
blocks.zh: 在前一個設計的基礎上，我們在培養液儲液槽加入 200rpm 的磁攪拌，以防止沉降並確保養分分布均勻。此外，取樣段被移到更靠近培養液儲液槽的位置，以取得更準確的量測，因為儲液槽的相對體積遠大於中空纖維薄膜，這樣能對整個生物反應器模組的總 OD 給出更接近平均的預測。
B建構

blocks.en: The same loop with the 200 rpm magnetic stirrer under the reservoir and the sampler moved to its outlet; the drawing below is the team’s own illustration of the prototype.
blocks.text: The same loop with the 200 rpm magnetic stirrer under the reservoir and the sampler moved to its outlet; the drawing below is the team’s own illustration of the prototype.
blocks.zh: 同一個迴路，在儲液槽下方加上 200 rpm 磁攪拌器，取樣器移到儲液槽出口；下面的圖是團隊自己繪製的原型插圖。
T測試

blocks.en: As before, the peristaltic pump maintained the target flow rate of 94 mL/min for the entirety of testing. However, instead of experimenting with room temperature, the bioreactor(experiment) and flask(control) were maintained at 37 degrees Celsius. In contrast to our last attempt, this time the experiment ran successfully, helping us secure the full growth curve of our bacteria, with the bioreactor reaching the plateau phase (OD600 ~0.8-0.9) after 2 hours, and the flask reaching the plateau phase (OD600 ~0.6-0.8) after 4.5 hours.
blocks.text: As before, the peristaltic pump maintained the target flow rate of 94 mL/min for the entirety of testing. However, instead of experimenting with room temperature, the bioreactor(experiment) and flask(control) were maintained at 37 degrees Celsius. In contrast to our last attempt, this time the experiment ran successfully, helping us secure the full growth curve of our bacteria, with the bioreactor reaching the plateau phase (OD600 ~0.8-0.9) after 2 hours, and the flask reaching the plateau phase (OD600 ~0.6-0.8) after 4.5 hours.
blocks.zh: 與之前一樣，蠕動幫浦在整個測試期間維持 94 mL/min 的目標流量。不過這次不是在室溫下實驗，生物反應器（實驗組）與燒瓶（對照組）都維持在 37 攝氏度。與上一次嘗試相反，這次實驗順利跑完，讓我們拿到細菌的完整生長曲線：生物反應器在 2 小時後進入平台期（OD600 約 0.8-0.9），燒瓶在 4.5 小時後進入平台期（OD600 約 0.6-0.8）。
L學習

blocks.en: The successful generation of the OD600 growth curve confirmed and justified that adding the continuous magnetic stirring mechanism is crucial to preventing sedimentation and maintaining optimal system efficiency.
blocks.text: The successful generation of the OD600 growth curve confirmed and justified that adding the continuous magnetic stirring mechanism is crucial to preventing sedimentation and maintaining optimal system efficiency.
blocks.zh: 成功得到 OD600 生長曲線，確認並支持了加入連續磁攪拌機制對防止沉降、維持系統最佳效率是關鍵的。

blocks.en: Prototype II, 14 June 2026. The two changes are visible: the stirrer under the reservoir and the sampler moved to the reservoir outlet.
blocks.text: Prototype II, 14 June 2026. The two changes are visible: the stirrer under the reservoir and the sampler moved to the reservoir outlet.
blocks.zh: 原型 II，2026 年 6 月 14 日。兩項改動都看得見：儲液槽下方的攪拌器，以及移到儲液槽出口的取樣器。

blocks.en: The first complete growth curve out of the reactor, bioreactor against flask at 37 °C.
blocks.text: The first complete growth curve out of the reactor, bioreactor against flask at 37 °C.
blocks.zh: 反應器跑出的第一條完整生長曲線，37 °C 下生物反應器對燒瓶。

blocks.en: Show details What the team wrote about what comes next, and two things the cycle cannot say.
blocks.text: Show details What the team wrote about what comes next, and two things the cycle cannot say.
blocks.zh: 顯示細節 團隊對下一步寫下的內容，以及這個循環說不出來的兩件事。

blocks.en: Moving forward, the next DBTL cycle will evaluate the system’s performance and growth kinetics at a reduced temperature of 22°C. Moreover, to ensure the long-term reliability of our Bioreactor and prevent tube degradation observed in earlier trials, upgrading to higher-durability BPT tubing is necessary for the next round of testing.
blocks.text: Moving forward, the next DBTL cycle will evaluate the system’s performance and growth kinetics at a reduced temperature of 22°C. Moreover, to ensure the long-term reliability of our Bioreactor and prevent tube degradation observed in earlier trials, upgrading to higher-durability BPT tubing is necessary for the next round of testing.
blocks.zh: 接下來，下一個 DBTL 循環將評估系統在較低的 22°C 下的表現與生長動力學。此外，為了確保生物反應器的長期可靠度，並避免早期試驗中觀察到的管材劣化，下一輪測試必須換上更耐用的 BPT 管材。
三項改動一次發生

blocks.en: Stirring, the new sampling point and the move from room temperature to 37 °C all happened between prototype I and prototype II, so the improvement cannot be attributed to any one of them. The team records the same point on Development: a better-performing prototype only counts as progress once a controlled test says which change produced it. The experiment that would separate them, stirring alone at room temperature, has not been run.
blocks.text: Stirring, the new sampling point and the move from room temperature to 37 °C all happened between prototype I and prototype II, so the improvement cannot be attributed to any one of them. The team records the same point on Development: a better-performing prototype only counts as progress once a controlled test says which change produced it. The experiment that would separate them, stirring alone at room temperature, has not been run.
blocks.zh: 攪拌、新的取樣點，以及從室溫改到 37 °C，全都發生在原型 I 與原型 II 之間，因此這次改善無法歸因於其中任何一項。團隊在開發頁記下同一點：一個表現更好的原型，只有在對照測試說出是哪一項改動造成的之後，才算是進展。能把它們分開的那個實驗，也就是在室溫下只加攪拌，還沒有做。

blocks.en: The two arms are not matched either. Both ran on the same medium at the same temperature, but the flask’s working volume, inoculum and shaking speed were never written down, against the reactor’s 300 mL, so the arms may differ in more than the thing being tested. No aeration path is described for this rig and dissolved oxygen was not measured, which also leaves open why either arm plateaus where it does. The difference between them reads as promising, not as measured.
blocks.text: The two arms are not matched either. Both ran on the same medium at the same temperature, but the flask’s working volume, inoculum and shaking speed were never written down, against the reactor’s 300 mL, so the arms may differ in more than the thing being tested. No aeration path is described for this rig and dissolved oxygen was not measured, which also leaves open why either arm plateaus where it does. The difference between them reads as promising, not as measured.
blocks.zh: 兩個組也並不匹配。兩者用同樣的培養液、在同樣的溫度下跑，但燒瓶的工作體積、接種量與搖晃轉速都沒有寫下來，而反應器是 300 mL，因此兩組的差別可能不只在於要測試的那一項。這套裝置沒有描述任何通氣路徑，溶氧也沒有量測，這也讓兩組各自為何在那個位置進入平台期仍是未知。兩者之間的差異讀起來是有前景，而不是已經量到。

blocks.en: New tubing, the growth chamber temperature, and the photometer reading the loop instead of a pipette
blocks.text: New tubing, the growth chamber temperature, and the photometer reading the loop instead of a pipette
blocks.zh: 新管材、生長箱的溫度，以及用光度計而不是移液管來讀這個迴路
結果

blocks.en: Steady growth at 22 °C through the photometer, with the leak and degradation problems gone.
blocks.text: Steady growth at 22 °C through the photometer, with the leak and degradation problems gone.
blocks.zh: 透過光度計觀察，在 22 °C 下穩定生長，漏液與劣化的問題都不見了。
下一步改動

blocks.en: Instrument the loop: pressure, flow, and a valve that stays shut when the power is cut.
blocks.text: Instrument the loop: pressure, flow, and a valve that stays shut when the power is cut.
blocks.zh: 為迴路加裝儀器：壓力、流量，以及一個斷電後仍保持關閉的閥。
D設計

blocks.en: The tubing was upgraded to biocompatible BPT tubing. The system was evaluated at a reduced operating temperature of 22 °C, placing our experimental setup within our plant growth incubator. Furthermore, this test would be utilizing our self-made photometer design.
blocks.text: The tubing was upgraded to biocompatible BPT tubing. The system was evaluated at a reduced operating temperature of 22 °C, placing our experimental setup within our plant growth incubator. Furthermore, this test would be utilizing our self-made photometer design.
blocks.zh: 管材升級為生物相容的 BPT 管材。系統在較低的操作溫度 22 °C 下評估，實驗裝置放進我們的植物生長箱裡。此外，這次測試會使用我們自製的光度計設計。
B建構

blocks.en: The loop went into the incubator with the printed photometer tower plumbed into the return leg, downstream of the pump, where a longer plumb gives the pump’s sawtooth room to smooth out.
blocks.text: The loop went into the incubator with the printed photometer tower plumbed into the return leg, downstream of the pump, where a longer plumb gives the pump’s sawtooth room to smooth out.
blocks.zh: 迴路進了生長箱，列印出來的光度計塔接在幫浦下游的回流段上，較長的管路讓幫浦的鋸齒波有空間平滑下來。
T測試

blocks.en: The run itself is the 400-hour photometer record in the photometer track.
blocks.text: The run itself is the 400-hour photometer record in the photometer track.
blocks.zh: 這次運轉本身就是光度計軌線裡那份 400 小時的光度計紀錄。
L學習

blocks.en: Our B. sub is able to grow steadily while passing through our photometer, with our new tubing, at 22 degrees. It was dropped into the reservoir from a large height, creating slight bubbling that helped dissolve oxygen passively. The newly used BPT tubing resolved all leak and degradation issues.
blocks.text: Our B. sub is able to grow steadily while passing through our photometer, with our new tubing, at 22 degrees. It was dropped into the reservoir from a large height, creating slight bubbling that helped dissolve oxygen passively. The newly used BPT tubing resolved all leak and degradation issues.
blocks.zh: 我們的 B. sub 在 22 度下、用新管材、同時通過我們的光度計時，能夠穩定生長。培養液是從高處落進儲液槽的，產生輕微的氣泡，被動地幫助溶氧。新採用的 BPT 管材解決了所有漏液與劣化的問題。

blocks.en: 20 July 2026. The loop with the photometer in it, on the bottom shelf of the incubator and the plants under test above. The long photometer run started the next day.
blocks.text: 20 July 2026. The loop with the photometer in it, on the bottom shelf of the incubator and the plants under test above. The long photometer run started the next day.
blocks.zh: 2026 年 7 月 20 日。裝了光度計的迴路放在生長箱最下層，受測植物在上方。長時間的光度計運轉在隔天開始。

blocks.en: Show details One limitation the team wrote down, and one thing this loop did not have.
blocks.text: Show details One limitation the team wrote down, and one thing this loop did not have.
blocks.zh: 顯示細節 團隊寫下的一項限制，以及這個迴路沒有的一樣東西。

blocks.en: A limitation is that it took 200 hours to plateau due to a large drop that could’ve been caused by contamination.
blocks.text: A limitation is that it took 200 hours to plateau due to a large drop that could’ve been caused by contamination.
blocks.zh: 一項限制是，因為出現一次大幅下降，花了 200 小時才進入平台期，而那次下降可能是汙染造成的。

blocks.en: The same drafts also record that this growth run used a simplified circulation loop with no hollow-fiber module in it, at about 23 °C, and the reactor record goes no further than putting the run “on the bioreactor loop” in the document’s own words. The longest recording it counts with the membrane module actually fitted is the hundred and sixteen hours of cycle 5. So what this cycle proves is the tubing, the temperature and the in-line measurement: a 22 °C growth curve on the membrane loop is still an open parameter, and the only growth curve the membrane loop has is at 37 °C. The drop it mentions is the unexplained dip discussed in the photometer track.
blocks.text: The same drafts also record that this growth run used a simplified circulation loop with no hollow-fiber module in it, at about 23 °C, and the reactor record goes no further than putting the run “on the bioreactor loop” in the document’s own words. The longest recording it counts with the membrane module actually fitted is the hundred and sixteen hours of cycle 5. So what this cycle proves is the tubing, the temperature and the in-line measurement: a 22 °C growth curve on the membrane loop is still an open parameter, and the only growth curve the membrane loop has is at 37 °C. The drop it mentions is the unexplained dip discussed in the photometer track.
blocks.zh: 同樣的草稿也記載，這次生長運轉用的是簡化的循環迴路，裡面沒有裝中空纖維模組，溫度約 23 °C，而反應器紀錄只按文件自己的說法把這次運轉記為「在生物反應器迴路上」，再沒有更多。它所認列、真正裝上薄膜模組的最長紀錄，是循環 5 的一百一十六小時。所以這個循環證明的是管材、溫度與線上量測：薄膜迴路在 22 °C 的生長曲線仍是一個未決參數，而薄膜迴路唯一有的生長曲線是在 37 °C。它提到的那次下降，就是光度計軌線裡討論的那個無法解釋的凹陷。

L學習

blocks.en: Autonomy is blocked on sterility, not on electronics. Neither probe body survives autoclaving and the reservoir closes with a rubber septum, and no amount of firmware addresses that.
blocks.text: Autonomy is blocked on sterility, not on electronics. Neither probe body survives autoclaving and the reservoir closes with a rubber septum, and no amount of firmware addresses that.
blocks.zh: 自主運作卡住的是無菌，不是電子。兩支探針的本體都撐不過高壓滅菌，而儲液槽是用橡膠隔膜封口的，再多的韌體也解決不了這件事。

blocks.en: The answer in the end was to stop autoclaving the loop. The assembly guide sterilizes in place: a liter of 3.5 % hydrogen peroxide circulated for fifteen minutes, drained, then a liter of distilled water at a time until no peroxide is left and the rinse comes back neutral, which in our hands is about four rinses. The photometer is blanked after that and never before. It keeps the probes and the glass out of an autoclave, and it moves the problem without solving it: this is chemical disinfection of an assembled loop, and the manual still treats everything the loop has held as biological waste at the end of a run.

blocks.zh: 最後的答案是不要再對整個迴路做高壓滅菌。組裝指南改成原地滅菌：循環一公升 3.5 % 過氧化氫十五分鐘，排掉，然後一次一公升蒸餾水沖洗，直到沒有過氧化氫殘留、沖洗液回到中性為止，在我們手上大約是四次沖洗。光度計在這之後才歸零，絕不在之前。這讓探針與玻璃不必進高壓滅菌鍋，也把問題搬走而沒有解決：這是對一個已組裝迴路的化學消毒，而手冊仍然把運轉結束時迴路裡裝過的一切當作生物廢棄物處理。

blocks.en: No test was run because none was needed: the arithmetic settles it by a factor of ten to thirty, and we scaled down. The valve went the same way. Four criteria were agreed before any option was scored, so they could not be bent toward the answer: does it stay shut when power is cut, how much holding force against permeate pressure, can we build it from parts already in the lab, and how much firmware does it need. A stepper releases when it loses power and the loop is full of live engineered culture, so the first criterion outranked the other three and decided it alone. We replaced a valve we had already built with a servo.

blocks.en: Freezing the specification meant checking every line against invoices instead of against memory, and two of our own recorded claims did not survive. The old specification said the membrane had a 50 kDa molecular weight cut-off and blocked outer-membrane vesicles. The module we actually own is 0.2 µm microfiltration, which passes small vesicles and cell debris along with the roughly 36 kDa ACC deaminase that is meant to pass. The barrier is cellular, not molecular, and we withdrew both claims in writing.

blocks.en: The transducers this cycle fitted are the ones the next question needed, and the answer took until October. Transmembrane pressure across a multi-day run was the record’s highest-priority open parameter, because a cake of retained cells and debris on the lumen wall is the most likely limit on service life. The run of 14 to 16 October turned the measurement into a trend: the pressure the module needs beyond what clean water needs at the same flow rose from 2.0 to 3.8 kPa across 42 hours, with two excursions where the permeate line was opened. Nothing had to be cleaned, and one run sets no replacement interval.

blocks.zh: 這個循環裝上的傳感器，正是下一個問題所需要的，而答案等到十月才出現。跨多天運轉的跨膜壓差是紀錄中優先度最高的未決參數，因為管腔壁上由滯留細胞與碎片形成的濾餅，是使用壽命最可能的限制。10 月 14 至 16 日的運轉把這項量測變成了趨勢：在相同流量下，模組所需的壓力比清水所需的高出多少，在 42 小時內從 2.0 升到 3.8 kPa，其間有兩次因為打開滲透液管路而出現的偏離。期間不需要做任何清洗，而一次運轉無法訂出更換週期。
兩種模組幾何，定案

blocks.en: Our own records carried two: the module frozen on 4 July at 150 cm² across eight fibers, and the module characterized on 16 August at 200 cm² across eleven. The second is the one in the machine. The user manual specifies an mPES hollow-fiber module, 0.2 µm pore, 200 cm² over eleven fibers, and the scale arithmetic in the table above was done on eleven fibers all along.

blocks.zh: 我們自己的紀錄裡有兩種：7 月 4 日定下的模組是八根纖維共 150 cm²，8 月 16 日做特性分析的模組是十一根纖維共 200 cm²。機器裡的是後者。使用手冊規定的是 mPES 中空纖維模組、0.2 µm 孔徑、十一根纖維共 200 cm²，而上表的規模算術一直都是以十一根纖維計算的。

blocks.en: The transducers have a procedure now as well. They are zeroed with every line vented and both pumps stopped, the offsets are stored and pushed to the microcontroller, and a gravity self-test measures the liquid column between the module’s two ends so the controller can subtract it; the test is a thirty-second recording and it has to be a plateau drifting no more than 0.15 kPa a minute. They remain 1 MPa parts working at a few tens of kPa, so the manual still tells the operator to read pressure as a trend and not to trust a single absolute value.

blocks.zh: 傳感器現在也有一套程序。歸零時所有管路都要洩壓、兩顆幫浦都要停止，偏移量會被儲存並推送到微控制器；另有一項重力自我測試，量測模組兩端之間的液柱，讓控制器可以把它扣掉；這項測試是三十秒的紀錄，而且必須是一段平台，每分鐘漂移不超過 0.15 kPa。它們仍然是工作在幾十 kPa 的 1 MPa 零件，所以手冊依然告訴操作者把壓力當趨勢讀，不要相信單一的絕對值。

blocks.en: Strain 168 made barely detectable ACC deaminase, so cycle 6 changes the host to WB800 and rewires the transducers. Separately, both machine builds went on: v2 put five servo valves and the safety interlocks on, v3 added pH control, the green strip and one operator interface.

blocks.zh: 菌株 168 做出的 ACC 去胺酶幾乎偵測不到，因此循環 6 把宿主換成 WB800，並重新接線傳感器。另一方面，兩套機器建構也同時進行：v2 裝上五顆伺服閥與安全連鎖，v3 加上 pH 控制、綠色燈條與一個操作介面。
D設計

blocks.en: This cycle tests integration. ACC deaminase is placed under a constitutive promoter so the strain expresses continuously, which removes light control as a variable. Culture circulates through the lumen side, protectant crosses into the shell side, and cells are retained. Everything else in the loop exists to keep that separation running unattended: a peristaltic pump circulates the culture, a medium reservoir feeds it, the in-line photometer reads OD600 without opening the system, and pressure and flow sensors confirm perfusion stays at the set rate.

Culture circulates through the lumen side, protectant crosses into the shell side, and cells are retained. Everything else in the loop exists to keep that separation running unattended: a peristaltic pump circulates the culture, a medium reservoir feeds it, the in-line photometer reads OD600 without opening the system, and pressure and flow sensors confirm perfusion stays at the set rate.
blocks.zh: 這個循環測試整合。ACC 去胺酶放在組成型啟動子之下，讓菌株持續表現，把光控制從變數中移除。培養液在管腔側循環，保護劑穿到殼側，細胞則被留住。迴路裡其他一切的存在，都是為了讓這個分離能無人看管地持續運作：一顆蠕動幫浦讓培養液循環，一個培養液儲液槽供料，線上光度計在不打開系統的情況下讀 OD600，而壓力與流量感測器確認灌流維持在設定值。
B建構

blocks.en: The rig went into the 37 °C incubator with the constitutive strain in a 500 mL reservoir, and every subsystem was switched on at the same time and logged to one file, on a 30 s median window so one row of the log covers the same interval on all three signals.
blocks.text: The rig went into the 37 °C incubator with the constitutive strain in a 500 mL reservoir, and every subsystem was switched on at the same time and logged to one file, on a 30 s median window so one row of the log covers the same interval on all three signals.
blocks.zh: 裝置放進 37 °C 培養箱，組成型菌株在 500 mL 儲液槽中，所有子系統同時開啟並記錄到同一個檔案，採 30 s 中位數視窗，使記錄中的一列在三個訊號上都涵蓋同一段時間。
T測試

blocks.en: The run started on 1 September 2026 and lasted 116 hours. Partway through, the computer running the microcontroller installed an update and shut down; the data were held in the web interface, so about 10 hours were lost. The culture reached a plateau at about 40 hours, and at about 47 hours a second growth phase began and continued to the end of the run.
blocks.text: The run started on 1 September 2026 and lasted 116 hours. Partway through, the computer running the microcontroller installed an update and shut down; the data were held in the web interface, so about 10 hours were lost. The culture reached a plateau at about 40 hours, and at about 47 hours a second growth phase began and continued to the end of the run.
blocks.zh: 這次運轉從 2026 年 9 月 1 日開始，持續 116 小時。中途，執行微控制器的電腦安裝更新後關機；數據保存在網頁介面中，因此損失約 10 小時。培養在約 40 小時進入平台期，約 47 小時開始第二個生長階段，並持續到運轉結束。

blocks.en: The pressure readings were unstable throughout. They did not respond when the loop was handled, and they did not return to baseline even with the main pump stopped.
blocks.text: The pressure readings were unstable throughout. They did not respond when the loop was handled, and they did not return to baseline even with the main pump stopped.
blocks.zh: 壓力讀值全程不穩。觸動迴路時它們沒有反應，即使主幫浦停止也沒有回到基線。

blocks.en: Engineered Bacillus subtilis was run in the system and ACC deaminase was secreted across the membrane. The blot behind that sentence is in the cloning track, the output library cycle: lumen-side cell lysate and medium against shell-side medium, sampled every two hours from 14 to 44 hours, with the ACC deaminase band at about 42 kDa. At that expression level a shell-side band is faint at best.

The blot behind that sentence is in the cloning track, the output library cycle: lumen-side cell lysate and medium against shell-side medium, sampled every two hours from 14 to 44 hours, with the ACC deaminase band at about 42 kDa. At that expression level a shell-side band is faint at best.
blocks.zh: 改造後的 Bacillus subtilis 在系統中運轉，ACC 去胺酶也分泌穿過薄膜。那句話背後的墨點圖在選殖軌線的輸出元件庫循環裡：管腔側的細胞裂解液與培養液對殼側培養液，從 14 到 44 小時每兩小時取樣一次，ACC 去胺酶的條帶約在 42 kDa。在那樣的表現量下，殼側的條帶頂多是微弱的。
L學習

blocks.en: Plateau at about 40 hours is the number this cycle establishes, and detectable ACC deaminase appears during that phase. Expression is weak.
blocks.text: Plateau at about 40 hours is the number this cycle establishes, and detectable ACC deaminase appears during that phase. Expression is weak.
blocks.zh: 約 40 小時進入平台期是這個循環建立的數字，而可偵測的 ACC 去胺酶就在那個階段出現。表現量很弱。

blocks.en: A second growth phase after plateau does not fit a batch curve. Our working explanation is that the erythromycin degraded and the cells began to lose the plasmid, lowering their metabolic burden. That is a theory from one run and not a measurement, and Professor Chang raised plasmid stability in September independently.
blocks.text: A second growth phase after plateau does not fit a batch curve. Our working explanation is that the erythromycin degraded and the cells began to lose the plasmid, lowering their metabolic burden. That is a theory from one run and not a measurement, and Professor Chang raised plasmid stability in September independently.
blocks.zh: 平台期之後又出現第二個生長階段，並不符合批次培養曲線。我們目前的解釋是紅黴素降解了，細胞開始失去質體，代謝負擔因而降低。這是從一次運轉得來的推測，不是量測結果，而 Professor Chang 在九月也獨立提出了質體穩定性的問題。

blocks.en: Strain 168 also produced barely detectable ACC deaminase, probably because it secretes protease into the medium and degrades its own product, so the next cycle moves to B. subtilis WB800. A pressure reading that will not come back to baseline with the pump stopped is not measuring pressure, and it had to be diagnosed before any claim could rest on it.
blocks.text: Strain 168 also produced barely detectable ACC deaminase, probably because it secretes protease into the medium and degrades its own product, so the next cycle moves to B. subtilis WB800. A pressure reading that will not come back to baseline with the pump stopped is not measuring pressure, and it had to be diagnosed before any claim could rest on it.
blocks.zh: 菌株 168 做出的 ACC 去胺酶同樣幾乎偵測不到，可能是因為它會把蛋白酶分泌到培養液中，降解自己的產物，因此下一個循環改用 B. subtilis WB800。一個在幫浦停止後仍不回到基線的壓力讀值，並不是在量壓力，必須先診斷清楚，任何主張才能建立在它上面。

blocks.en: The blot says the protectant crosses. It does not say how fast, and no shell-side concentration against time was measured in this run, so the protectant transfer rate is open, and it, not growth, may be what sets throughput. No medium feed was fitted, either, so what was taken off the shell side was never replaced.

No medium feed was fitted, either, so what was taken off the shell side was never replaced.
blocks.zh: 墨點圖說保護劑穿得過去。它沒有說速度有多快，而這次運轉也沒有量殼側濃度隨時間的變化，因此保護劑的傳輸速率仍未決，而決定產出速率的可能是它，而不是生長。這次也沒有裝培養液補給，所以從殼側取走的東西從未被補回。

blocks.en: The loop as this cycle built it. The shell side still closes on itself with a Luer valve for sampling, so there is no product bottle and nothing driving permeate across the membrane; both arrive in cycles 6 and 8.
blocks.text: The loop as this cycle built it. The shell side still closes on itself with a Luer valve for sampling, so there is no product bottle and nothing driving permeate across the membrane; both arrive in cycles 6 and 8.
blocks.zh: 這個循環所建的迴路。殼側仍以一個 Luer 閥自行閉合供取樣，因此沒有產物瓶，也沒有任何東西驅動滲透液穿過薄膜；這兩者在循環 6 與 8 才出現。

blocks.en: The rig seven minutes into the run, everything inside the 37 °C incubator. The screen reads OD600 0.1738 AU at 06:58 elapsed.
blocks.text: The rig seven minutes into the run, everything inside the 37 °C incubator. The screen reads OD600 0.1738 AU at 06:58 elapsed.
blocks.zh: 運轉開始七分鐘時的裝置，全部在 37 °C 培養箱內。螢幕在經過 06:58 時顯示 OD600 0.1738 AU。

blocks.en: The same dashboard at 53 h 22 min, about half way through the run, read against the same blank, which is what makes the two OD600 numbers comparable.
blocks.text: The same dashboard at 53 h 22 min, about half way through the run, read against the same blank, which is what makes the two OD600 numbers comparable.
blocks.zh: 同一個儀表板在 53 h 22 min、大約運轉過半時，以同一個空白值為基準讀取，這也是兩個 OD600 數字可以比較的原因。

blocks.en: OD600 read in line across the whole run. The gray band is the ten hours lost to the computer restarting. The curve flattens near 40 h and climbs again from about 47 h, which is the second growth phase the learn step has no measurement for.
blocks.text: OD600 read in line across the whole run. The gray band is the ten hours lost to the computer restarting. The curve flattens near 40 h and climbs again from about 47 h, which is the second growth phase the learn step has no measurement for.
blocks.zh: 整個運轉期間線上讀取的 OD600。灰色帶是電腦重新啟動所損失的十小時。曲線在接近 40 h 轉平，約 47 h 起再次上升，這就是學習步驟沒有量測的第二個生長階段。

blocks.en: Feed pressure and transmembrane pressure over the same run. The difference between the sensors stays flat along zero while the absolute readings drift and spike, which is how a run can produce a usable transmembrane trace and an unusable pressure sensor at the same time.
blocks.text: Feed pressure and transmembrane pressure over the same run. The difference between the sensors stays flat along zero while the absolute readings drift and spike, which is how a run can produce a usable transmembrane trace and an unusable pressure sensor at the same time.
blocks.zh: 同一次運轉的進料壓力與跨膜壓差。感測器之間的差值沿著零維持平穩，而絕對讀值則漂移並出現尖峰，這就是一次運轉為何能同時產出可用的跨膜壓差曲線與不可用的壓力感測器。

blocks.en: Show details The run read end to end, what the flat pressure does and does not prove, and where the secretion claim stands.
blocks.text: Show details The run read end to end, what the flat pressure does and does not prove, and where the secretion claim stands.
blocks.zh: 顯示細節 整段運轉從頭讀到尾、平穩的壓力證明了什麼又沒證明什麼，以及分泌這項主張目前的狀態。

blocks.en: Two readings off the same dashboard, seven minutes in and 53 h 22 min in. Neither is the end of the run: the logged series runs to 102.4 h and OD600 3.77, and the 0.1738 below is what the screen showed seven minutes in and is not in the logged file.

blocks.zh: 同一個儀表板上的兩次讀值，分別在開始後七分鐘與 53 h 22 min。兩者都不是運轉結束：記錄的序列跑到 102.4 h、OD600 3.77，而下面的 0.1738 是螢幕在七分鐘時顯示的值，並不在記錄檔裡。

幫浦

blocks.en: Peristaltic at the same duty cycle, forward, for the whole run
blocks.text: Peristaltic at the same duty cycle, forward, for the whole run
blocks.zh: 蠕動幫浦全程以相同工作週期正轉

blocks.en: Three rows account for most of the result. Bubble rejection stayed at zero for the whole run, which is the fault the photometer’s first three builds were destroyed by. Transmembrane pressure did not move: three sensors that agree to within 0.005 bar at the start still agree at the end, after 1132 L. And the pump never changed setting, so the flow difference between the two columns is the loop’s own behavior and not an operator.
blocks.text: Three rows account for most of the result. Bubble rejection stayed at zero for the whole run, which is the fault the photometer’s first three builds were destroyed by. Transmembrane pressure did not move: three sensors that agree to within 0.005 bar at the start still agree at the end, after 1132 L. And the pump never changed setting, so the flow difference between the two columns is the loop’s own behavior and not an operator.
blocks.zh: 大部分結果由三列數據說明。氣泡剔除全程維持在零，而這正是摧毀光度計前三個版本的那個毛病。跨膜壓差沒有移動：三顆感測器在開始時彼此相差不到 0.005 bar，在 1132 L 之後仍然一致。而幫浦從未改過設定，因此兩欄之間的流量差異是迴路自己的行為，不是操作者造成的。

blocks.en: A flat transmembrane pressure across the run is the first fouling datum this project has. It is a weaker claim than it sounds: the membrane is 0.2 µm and the loop runs at essentially zero pressure difference across it, so what it shows is a hundred and sixteen hours without fouling under mild conditions. It also sits beside a sensor the same run reports as untrustworthy, so it is a difference that held, not an absolute pressure anyone would quote. It rules out the failure mode that would have stopped the run; it does not predict a season in a field. One earlier test stands behind it: on 16 August the module was run on pure water across eight flow settings, twice, once fitted and once replaced by plain tubing, which showed that the valves, fittings and flow cuvette account for 46 to 55 % of the total pressure drop. Not subtracting them would overstate the membrane’s resistance by nearly a factor of two.

It also sits beside a sensor the same run reports as untrustworthy, so it is a difference that held, not an absolute pressure anyone would quote. It rules out the failure mode that would have stopped the run; it does not predict a season in a field. Not subtracting them would overstate the membrane’s resistance by nearly a factor of two.
blocks.zh: 整段運轉中跨膜壓差保持平穩，是本計畫第一筆關於積垢的數據。它比聽起來更弱：薄膜是 0.2 µm，而迴路兩側的壓差基本上是零，所以它顯示的是在溫和條件下一百一十六小時沒有積垢。它旁邊還擺著同一次運轉自己報告為不可信的感測器，因此它是一個維持住的差值，而不是任何人會引用的絕對壓力。它排除了會讓運轉停下來的那種失效模式；它無法預測田間的一整季。它背後有一次較早的測試：8 月 16 日，模組在純水下以八種流量設定各測兩次，一次裝著模組、一次換成普通管材，結果顯示閥、接頭與流量槽佔總壓降的 46 到 55 %。不把它們扣掉，會把薄膜的阻力高估將近一倍。

blocks.en: October gave it a second, better datum. Over 42 hours from the 14th to the 16th, the pressure the module needs beyond what clean water needs at the same flow rose from 2.0 to 3.8 kPa, with two excursions where the permeate line was opened. That is the rising trend a fouling measurement is supposed to show, and it is measured against a clean-membrane sweep taken on the same module, so the valves and fittings come out of the number instead of being left in it. It is still one run on one module. Nothing had to be cleaned, no replacement interval follows from it, and none of the controller’s fouling thresholds has been reached by anything we have run: permeability below 70 % of steady state, friction or shear ratio above 1.3.

blocks.zh: 十月給了它第二筆、更好的數據。從 14 日到 16 日的 42 小時間，在相同流量下模組所需的壓力比清水所需的高出多少，從 2.0 升到 3.8 kPa，其間有兩次因為打開滲透液管路而出現的偏離。這就是一個積垢量測應該呈現的上升趨勢，而且是對照同一個模組上取得的乾淨薄膜掃描來量的，所以閥與接頭被扣除在這個數字之外，而不是留在裡面。它仍然是一個模組上的一次運轉。期間不需要做任何清洗，也推不出更換週期，而我們跑過的任何東西都沒有觸及控制器的積垢門檻：透過率低於穩態的 70 %、摩擦或剪切比高於 1.3。

blocks.en: Because the shell side exists and can be sampled, this rig is the only apparatus in the project that can be asked whether something crosses a membrane.
blocks.text: Because the shell side exists and can be sampled, this rig is the only apparatus in the project that can be asked whether something crosses a membrane.
blocks.zh: 因為殼側存在而且可以取樣，這套裝置是本計畫中唯一能被拿來問「某個東西是否穿過薄膜」的設備。

blocks.en: What the two machine builds added
blocks.text: What the two machine builds added
blocks.zh: 兩套機器建構加了什麼

blocks.en: September’s run was every subsystem switched on at once with a person watching. What went on the machine after it is the part that lets the person look away, and cycles 6 and 7 are the runs on it. Five bus servos replaced hands: one on the pinch valve and four on the membrane’s own Luer valves, each with three positions, among them the shell sampling valve and the feed valve. pH control came with them, and it is deliberately one-sided. It adds base, with no acid and no carbon dioxide, so a pH that climbs raises an alarm and nothing else. It doses below the target minus the deadband, then waits at least a minute and until the pH has stopped moving before it doses again, and if three pulses in a row fail to shift the pH it latches a fault and stops: an empty base bottle and a blocked line look the same from the controller, and both of them want a person. Everything is driven from one web interface on the board, in English or Traditional Chinese, with a seven-inch screen on the machine for the times nobody has a laptop.

Everything is driven from one web interface on the board, in English or Traditional Chinese, with a seven-inch screen on the machine for the times nobody has a laptop.
blocks.zh: 九月的運轉是所有子系統一次全開，並且有人看著。在那之後裝上機器的東西，才是讓人可以移開目光的部分，而循環 6 與 7 就是在它上面跑的。五顆總線伺服馬達取代了手：一顆在夾管閥上，四顆在薄膜自己的 Luer 閥上，每一顆有三個位置，其中包括殼側取樣閥與進料閥。pH 控制和它們一起來，而且刻意只做單向。它只加鹼，沒有酸也沒有二氧化碳，因此 pH 上升只會發出警報，別的什麼也不做。它在低於目標減去死區時加藥，然後至少等一分鐘、並等到 pH 停止移動後才再加一次；若連續三次脈衝都無法改變 pH，它就閂住一個故障並停止：鹼瓶空了與管路堵住在控制器看來一樣，兩者都需要人。一切都從板子上的同一個網頁介面操作，可選英文或繁體中文，機器上還有一片七吋螢幕，供沒有人帶筆電的時候使用。

blocks.en: Where the interlocks live matters as much as what they check. A pinch that drives lumen-in pressure or transmembrane pressure past its limit for five samples running, a pinch held past the maximum pinch time, a servo over its thermal cut-out, a servo that fails to answer three times: each releases the valve and latches a fault, and pinching is refused until a person clears it. A pressure trip is separate and harder: any one of the three pressures over the trip limit for five samples stops both pumps, releases the pinch and refuses every pump command above zero until the pressure has come back down. These run on the microcontroller, not in the browser and not on the Linux side, so they keep working when the interface dies; and rebooting clears the microcontroller’s latch but not the other, which is the detail that stops a reboot from restarting a pump in an empty room.

A pressure trip is separate and harder: any one of the three pressures over the trip limit for five samples stops both pumps, releases the pinch and refuses every pump command above zero until the pressure has come back down. These run on the microcontroller, not in the browser and not on the Linux side, so they keep working when the interface dies; and rebooting clears the microcontroller’s latch but not the other, which is the detail that stops a reboot from restarting a pump in an empty room.
blocks.zh: 連鎖裝在哪裡，和它檢查什麼一樣重要。夾管動作若讓管腔入口壓力或跨膜壓差連續五個取樣超過限值、夾管超過最長夾管時間、伺服馬達超過熱斷路點、伺服馬達連續三次沒有回應：以上任一種都會釋放閥並閂住故障，而且在有人清除之前都拒絕夾管。壓力跳脫是另一回事，也更嚴格：三個壓力中任何一個連續五個取樣超過跳脫限值，就會停止兩顆幫浦、釋放夾管，並在壓力降下來之前拒絕任何大於零的幫浦指令。這些都跑在微控制器上，不在瀏覽器裡、也不在 Linux 那一側，所以介面掛掉時它們仍然有效；而重新開機會清除微控制器的閂鎖，卻不會清除另一個，這個細節正是讓重新開機不會在無人的房間裡重啟幫浦的原因。

blocks.en: The same document lists what the machine still will not do. There is no level sensing and no closed-loop feeding, so the reservoir and the permeate bottle are watched by an operator. No cleaning protocol for the membrane exists: a fouled module is replaced, not cleaned. Pressure monitoring is not allowed to stand in for looking: the bench and the incubator floor are checked by eye at every round, and again before a run is left alone. And the shell side is plated on the first run after every module change, with the harvest treated as live culture until that plate has grown nothing, because a 0.2 µm pore sorts by size and the only thing it is known to hold back is a whole cell.

D設計

blocks.en: This cycle answers cycle 5 and the Owl Lab electronics review at once, so the changes come in three groups. The host strain changed from Bacillus subtilis 168 to B. subtilis WB800, which is deficient in secretory proteases, so we expected it to stop degrading its own ACC deaminase and show the yield 168 could not.
blocks.text: This cycle answers cycle 5 and the Owl Lab electronics review at once, so the changes come in three groups. The host strain changed from Bacillus subtilis 168 to B. subtilis WB800, which is deficient in secretory proteases, so we expected it to stop degrading its own ACC deaminase and show the yield 168 could not.
blocks.zh: 這個循環同時回應循環 5 與 Owl Lab 的電子檢討，因此改動分成三組。宿主菌株從 Bacillus subtilis 168 換成 B. subtilis WB800，後者缺少分泌型蛋白酶，因此我們預期它不再降解自己的 ACC 去胺酶，並呈現出 168 做不到的產量。

blocks.en: The pressure transducers had read unstably, so they now run on 12 V DC instead of 5 V, grounded on the DC-DC module instead of the Arduino Uno Q. The old power supply could not deliver the current the motors and pumps need once valve and pump control were added, and the mainboard Owl Lab proposed supplies both the voltage and the current. Servo control moved from a PCA9685 driver to STS3215 servos over UART on the same advice, because a driver that reaches only 85° when commanded to 90° leaves a valve off its position, and a valve off its position can spike pressure enough to burst tubing.

The old power supply could not deliver the current the motors and pumps need once valve and pump control were added, and the mainboard Owl Lab proposed supplies both the voltage and the current. Servo control moved from a PCA9685 driver to STS3215 servos over UART on the same advice, because a driver that reaches only 85° when commanded to 90° leaves a valve off its position, and a valve off its position can spike pressure enough to burst tubing.
blocks.zh: 壓力傳感器原本讀值不穩，現在改用 12 V DC 而非 5 V，接地接在 DC-DC 模組而不是 Arduino Uno Q 上。加入閥與幫浦控制之後，舊的電源供應無法提供馬達與幫浦所需的電流，而 Owl Lab 提議的主板同時能提供電壓與電流。伺服控制也依同一建議從 PCA9685 驅動器改為透過 UART 的 STS3215 伺服馬達，因為一個被指令轉到 90° 卻只到 85° 的驅動器會讓閥停在錯的位置，而停在錯位置的閥可能讓壓力飆到足以把管子爆開。

blocks.en: Two parts were added, both plugging into the mainboard as modules: a pH probe and a servo-driven pinch valve. The valve raises the transmembrane pressure to drive product from the lumen side to the shell side, closing the gap Professor Chang identified in June, which is that raising the flow rate only recirculates fluid and generates no outward pressure. The medium volume went from 500 mL to 1 L, still at 37 °C.

blocks.zh: 新增兩個零件，兩者都以模組方式插在主板上：一支 pH 探針與一個伺服驅動的夾管閥。這個閥會提高跨膜壓差，把產物從管腔側推到殼側，補上 Professor Chang 在六月指出的缺口：單純提高流量只是讓液體再循環，不會產生向外的壓力。培養液體積從 500 mL 增加到 1 L，溫度仍為 37 °C。
B建構

blocks.en: The shell side now drains to a reservoir that collects the product. The lumen side has three pressure transducers, one flowmeter, the in-line photometer, the pinch valve and the pH probe. The pinch valve is a printed body holding an STS3215 12 V servo motor, and it clamps the return line about 50 mm from the lumen outlet. The pH probe sits in a slot in the culture bottle’s cap, and the dosing pump at 5 mL/min draws from a small KOH bottle through a Luer valve into the same return line.

blocks.en: The pH and OD readings were unstable throughout, most likely because the photometer and the pH sensor were incorrectly calibrated, so the run was stopped early: 37.5 h logged across four files. The in-line OD600 rose from 0.10 to 0.30 over the first nine hours and then stopped tracking growth, with more than 20 % bubble interference in about one measurement window in six and the reference beam varying by a factor of 4.8. The pH fell from 6.55 to about 6.22 over the first eight hours before the trace broke up.

The in-line OD600 rose from 0.10 to 0.30 over the first nine hours and then stopped tracking growth, with more than 20 % bubble interference in about one measurement window in six and the reference beam varying by a factor of 4.8. blocks.zh: pH 與 OD 讀值全程不穩，最可能的原因是光度計與 pH 感測器校正不正確，因此這次運轉提早停止：記錄 37.5 h，分成四個檔案。線上 OD600 在前九小時從 0.10 升到 0.30，之後就不再跟得上生長，大約每六個量測視窗就有一個出現超過 20 % 的氣泡干擾，參考光束的變動達 4.8 倍。pH 在前八小時從 6.55 降到約 6.22，之後曲線就散掉了。

blocks.en: ACC deaminase was measured on both sides by two assays. The DNPH assay reads enzyme activity through the α-ketobutyrate released when ACC deaminase breaks ACC down, and we adopted it on Professor Chang’s advice as a way to show the protectant is made. The ELISA reads the amount of protein. The pressure transducers read stably in this run.
blocks.text: ACC deaminase was measured on both sides by two assays. The DNPH assay reads enzyme activity through the α-ketobutyrate released when ACC deaminase breaks ACC down, and we adopted it on Professor Chang’s advice as a way to show the protectant is made. The ELISA reads the amount of protein. The pressure transducers read stably in this run.
blocks.zh: ACC 去胺酶在兩側都以兩種檢測量測。DNPH 檢測是透過 ACC 去胺酶分解 ACC 時釋出的 α-酮丁酸來讀酵素活性，我們依 Professor Chang 的建議採用它，作為顯示保護劑確實被做出來的方法。ELISA 讀的是蛋白質的量。這次運轉中壓力傳感器讀值穩定。
L學習

blocks.en: The bacteria made ACC deaminase in the loop, about 10 µg/mL by ELISA in this one run, and the DNPH assay found activity on both sides. Because the shell side held about as much of each protectant as the lumen side, later runs sample the shell side only, which removes a contamination route and simplifies the setup.
blocks.text: The bacteria made ACC deaminase in the loop, about 10 µg/mL by ELISA in this one run, and the DNPH assay found activity on both sides. Because the shell side held about as much of each protectant as the lumen side, later runs sample the shell side only, which removes a contamination route and simplifies the setup.
blocks.zh: 細菌在迴路中做出了 ACC 去胺酶，這一次運轉以 ELISA 讀到約 10 µg/mL，而 DNPH 檢測在兩側都找到活性。由於殼側所含的每一種保護劑都與管腔側差不多，後續的運轉只取殼側樣品，這樣可以移除一條汙染途徑，也讓設置更簡單。

blocks.en: A later run read both ports again on a fitted standard curve and agrees: the lumen side gives 7.7, 8.5, 6.3 and 4.5 µg/mL at 1, 16, 24 and 40 h and the shell side 5.7, 8.0, 6.6 and 5.5. Two runs now put the same order of protein on both sides of the wall, so sampling the shell side alone loses nothing. The run sampled from the shell side alone held ACC deaminase for 72 hours.

Two runs now put the same order of protein on both sides of the wall, so sampling the shell side alone loses nothing. The run sampled from the shell side alone held ACC deaminase for 72 hours.
blocks.zh: 後來一次運轉以擬合的標準曲線再次讀了兩個取樣口，結果一致：管腔側在 1、16、24 與 40 h 分別為 7.7、8.5、6.3 與 4.5 µg/mL，殼側為 5.7、8.0、6.6 與 5.5。現在有兩次運轉在薄膜兩側都測到同一數量級的蛋白質，因此只取殼側並不會失去什麼。只從殼側取樣的那次運轉，ACC 去胺酶維持了 72 小時。

blocks.en: The rewiring fixed the transducers, so no further change is needed there. The pH shifted during the run and needs confirming. Few bubbles formed in the medium reservoir, so we suspect oxygen limitation, and the next cycle takes the reservoir back to 500 mL to test that: the surface available for oxygen diffusion is the same whatever the volume, while the amount of bacteria scales with it.

The ELISA pairs run 4.6 to 8.6 µg/mL in the lumen against 5.8 to 8.1 on the shell side, which is the range the team’s own write-up quotes for this run. The 40 h lumen sample has no activity reading, so no specific activity is plotted for it.
blocks.text: The same run read as a time course, not a single point: ACC deaminase by ELISA (A), its activity by DNPH (B), and the two divided to give specific activity (C), lumen against shell at 1, 16, 24 and 40 hours. The ELISA pairs run 4.6 to 8.6 µg/mL in the lumen against 5.8 to 8.1 on the shell side, which is the range the team’s own write-up quotes for this run. The 40 h lumen sample has no activity reading, so no specific activity is plotted for it.
blocks.zh: 同一次運轉以時間歷程而非單點來讀：ELISA 測得的 ACC 去胺酶（A）、DNPH 測得的活性（B），以及兩者相除得到的比活性（C），管腔側對殼側，時間點為 1、16、24 與 40 小時。ELISA 的配對值在管腔側為 4.6 到 8.6 µg/mL，殼側為 5.8 到 8.1，這也是團隊自己的書寫為這次運轉所引用的範圍。40 h 的管腔樣品沒有活性讀值，因此沒有為它畫比活性。

blocks.en: Two records of the same experiment sit beside each other here and neither is adopted over the other. The table above is a back-calculated single value per protectant; the chart is a four-point course for ACC deaminase alone, and its numbers are roughly half the table’s. What both agree on, which is the claim this cycle rests on, is that the lumen and shell readings are close to each other at every point.

The table above is a back-calculated single value per protectant; the chart is a four-point course for ACC deaminase alone, and its numbers are roughly half the table’s. blocks.zh: 同一個實驗的兩份紀錄並列在這裡，兩者都沒有被另一份取代。上面的表格是每一種保護劑反推出的單一數值；那張圖只針對 ACC 去胺酶、有四個時間點，而它的數字大約是表格的一半。兩者都同意的、也是這個循環所依據的主張，是管腔與殼側的讀值在每一個時間點都彼此接近。

blocks.en: The DNPH assay detected ACC deaminase activity on both sides, read as α-ketobutyrate against its standard curve. Shell-side values stayed between 0.16 and 0.29 mM across four samples; lumen values ran from 0.25 to 0.60 mM over the first 24 h. The readings sit at the low end of the standard range, 0 to 4.1 mM, and the 40 h lumen sample reads below zero at −0.13 mM, so these activity values are approximate.

Shell-side values stayed between 0.16 and 0.29 mM across four samples; lumen values ran from 0.25 to 0.60 mM over the first 24 h. The readings sit at the low end of the standard range, 0 to 4.1 mM, and the 40 h lumen sample reads below zero at −0.13 mM, so these activity values are approximate.
blocks.zh: DNPH 檢測在兩側都偵測到 ACC 去胺酶活性，以 α-酮丁酸對照其標準曲線讀取。四個樣品的殼側值維持在 0.16 到 0.29 mM 之間；管腔值在前 24 h 從 0.25 到 0.60 mM。這些讀值落在標準範圍（0 到 4.1 mM）的低端，而 40 h 的管腔樣品讀到低於零的 −0.13 mM，因此這些活性值只是近似值。

blocks.en: The DNPH standard curve with the samples on it. Every sample sits in the bottom corner of a curve built to 4.1 mM, which is why the activity numbers are quoted as approximate and no rate is calculated from them. The 28 h series on the chart is not explained anywhere in our records.

blocks.zh: DNPH 標準曲線與落在上面的樣品。每一個樣品都落在一條建到 4.1 mM 的曲線的最底角，這就是為什麼活性數字只以近似值引用，也不從它們算出任何速率。圖上的 28 h 系列在我們的紀錄中任何地方都沒有解釋。

blocks.en: Clean curves to thirty-eight hours, and then a valve our own cleaning procedure had weakened broke in half
blocks.text: Clean curves to thirty-eight hours, and then a valve our own cleaning procedure had weakened broke in half
blocks.zh: 乾淨的曲線撐到三十八小時，接著一個被我們自己的清洗程序弄弱的閥斷成兩半
結果

blocks.en: OD600 0.14 to 2.71 by 37 h, a fitted growth rate of 0.286 ± 0.010 h−1 inside the interval registered before the run, and a continuous transmembrane pressure record rising 2.0 to 3.8 kPa over 42 hours.
blocks.text: OD600 0.14 to 2.71 by 37 h, a fitted growth rate of 0.286 ± 0.010 h−1 inside the interval registered before the run, and a continuous transmembrane pressure record rising 2.0 to 3.8 kPa over 42 hours.
blocks.zh: 到 37 h 時 OD600 從 0.14 到 2.71，擬合生長速率 0.286 ± 0.010 h−1，落在運轉前登錄的區間內，並有一份連續的跨膜壓差紀錄，在 42 小時內從 2.0 升到 3.8 kPa。
下一步改動

blocks.en: Automatic pH correction, and a replication run to document a complete growth curve. Both are cycle 8.
blocks.text: Automatic pH correction, and a replication run to document a complete growth curve. Both are cycle 8.
blocks.zh: 自動 pH 校正，以及一次重複運轉以記錄完整的生長曲線。兩者都是循環 8。
D設計

blocks.en: Cycle 6 left the medium too acidic. A pH of 6.5 or lower impairs Bacillus subtilis growth and cell division and the structural stability of the protectant enzyme, so the medium needed a way to be brought back up. The pH probe stayed on the lumen side, and KOH was added whenever the reading dropped.
blocks.text: Cycle 6 left the medium too acidic. A pH of 6.5 or lower impairs Bacillus subtilis growth and cell division and the structural stability of the protectant enzyme, so the medium needed a way to be brought back up. The pH probe stayed on the lumen side, and KOH was added whenever the reading dropped.
blocks.zh: 循環 6 讓培養液太酸。pH 6.5 或更低會損害 Bacillus subtilis 的生長與細胞分裂，也會損害保護劑酵素的結構穩定性，因此培養液需要一個把 pH 拉回來的方法。pH 探針留在管腔側，讀值一下降就加入 KOH。

blocks.en: We also needed sterility without an autoclave, because the assembled loop cannot go into one. This cycle developed a chemical clean-in-place procedure to replace it. After assembly, 900 mL of distilled water and then 100 mL of 35 % hydrogen peroxide are pumped in, mix in the lumen reservoir and circulate for 30 to 60 minutes, and a starch-iodide test paper checks for peroxide. The solution is drained through a tube, which is then reattached to close the loop. One liter of distilled water then circulates for 30 minutes per wash, with a fresh test paper after each wash, until no peroxide remains. It usually takes five 1 L washes.
blocks.text: We also needed sterility without an autoclave, because the assembled loop cannot go into one. This cycle developed a chemical clean-in-place procedure to replace it. After assembly, 900 mL of distilled water and then 100 mL of 35 % hydrogen peroxide are pumped in, mix in the lumen reservoir and circulate for 30 to 60 minutes, and a starch-iodide test paper checks for peroxide. The solution is drained through a tube, which is then reattached to close the loop. One liter of distilled water then circulates for 30 minutes per wash, with a fresh test paper after each wash, until no peroxide remains. It usually takes five 1 L washes.
blocks.zh: 我們也需要在不用高壓滅菌鍋的情況下維持無菌，因為組裝好的迴路放不進去。這個循環發展出一套化學的原地清洗程序來取代它。組裝後打入 900 mL 蒸餾水，再打入 100 mL 35 % 過氧化氫，在管腔儲液槽中混合並循環 30 到 60 分鐘，再用澱粉碘化鉀試紙檢查過氧化氫。溶液從一條管子排出，之後再把管子接回去使迴路閉合。接著以一公升蒸餾水循環 30 分鐘為一次沖洗，每次沖洗後換一張新試紙，直到沒有過氧化氫殘留為止。通常需要五次一公升的沖洗。
B建構

blocks.en: The build followed cycle 6, on the same strain, with one change. We attributed the acidity to oxygen limitation, so the reservoir went from 1 L back to 500 mL: the same surface for oxygen diffusion then serves fewer bacteria. Permeate was halved with it, from 24 to 12 mL/min, which is a flux of 36 LMH across the module, and the photometer’s acceptance gate was running, so readings that fail its checks are dropped instead of being averaged in.
blocks.text: The build followed cycle 6, on the same strain, with one change. We attributed the acidity to oxygen limitation, so the reservoir went from 1 L back to 500 mL: the same surface for oxygen diffusion then serves fewer bacteria. Permeate was halved with it, from 24 to 12 mL/min, which is a flux of 36 LMH across the module, and the photometer’s acceptance gate was running, so readings that fail its checks are dropped instead of being averaged in.
blocks.zh: 建構沿用循環 6，菌株相同，只有一項改動。我們把酸化歸因於氧限制，因此儲液槽從 1 L 退回 500 mL：同樣的氧氣擴散表面因此服務較少的細菌。滲透液也跟著減半，從 24 降到 12 mL/min，相當於模組上 36 LMH 的通量；光度計的接受門檻也在運作中，因此未通過檢查的讀值會被丟掉，而不是被平均進去。
T測試

blocks.en: The run started on 14 October 2026. Protectant was drawn from the shell side at hours 1.10 and 18.38. At the 38-hour mark a Luer valve at the start of the lumen loop broke in half, unnoticed at the time, and medium leaked into the incubator.
blocks.text: The run started on 14 October 2026. Protectant was drawn from the shell side at hours 1.10 and 18.38. At the 38-hour mark a Luer valve at the start of the lumen loop broke in half, unnoticed at the time, and medium leaked into the incubator.
blocks.zh: 這次運轉在 2026 年 10 月 14 日開始。保護劑在第 1.10 與 18.38 小時從殼側取出。在第 38 小時，管腔迴路起點的一個 Luer 閥斷成兩半，當時沒有被發現，培養液漏進培養箱。

blocks.en: Before that point the pH and OD curves were reliable, showing growth and the pH response both to growth and to KOH. OD600 rose from 0.14 to 2.71 by 37 h, a fitted growth rate of 0.286 ± 0.010 h−1 over the window from 1.5 to 6.5 hours, which is a doubling time of 145 minutes. That is inside the range we registered before the run: on 1 October we predicted 0.2986 h−1 and set a pass between 0.2705 and 0.3300.
blocks.text: Before that point the pH and OD curves were reliable, showing growth and the pH response both to growth and to KOH. OD600 rose from 0.14 to 2.71 by 37 h, a fitted growth rate of 0.286 ± 0.010 h−1 over the window from 1.5 to 6.5 hours, which is a doubling time of 145 minutes. That is inside the range we registered before the run: on 1 October we predicted 0.2986 h−1 and set a pass between 0.2705 and 0.3300.
blocks.zh: 在那個時點之前，pH 與 OD 曲線都可靠，顯示出生長，以及 pH 對生長與對 KOH 的反應。到 37 h 時 OD600 從 0.14 升到 2.71，在 1.5 到 6.5 小時的視窗內擬合出 0.286 ± 0.010 h−1 的生長速率，相當於 145 分鐘的倍增時間。這落在我們運轉前登錄的範圍內：10 月 1 日我們預測 0.2986 h−1，並把通過區間設在 0.2705 到 0.3300 之間。

blocks.en: The run also gave the first continuous transmembrane pressure record covering a whole bioreactor run. The pressure the module needs beyond what clean water needs at the same flow rose from 2.0 to 3.8 kPa over about 42 hours, with nothing cleaned.
blocks.text: The run also gave the first continuous transmembrane pressure record covering a whole bioreactor run. The pressure the module needs beyond what clean water needs at the same flow rose from 2.0 to 3.8 kPa over about 42 hours, with nothing cleaned.
blocks.zh: 這次運轉也給出第一份涵蓋整段生物反應器運轉的連續跨膜壓差紀錄。在相同流量下，模組所需的壓力比清水所需的高出多少，在約 42 小時內從 2.0 升到 3.8 kPa，期間沒有清洗任何東西。
L學習

blocks.en: The broken valve traces back to our own clean-in-place step. We had assumed that 35 % hydrogen peroxide would be diluted once it mixed in the reservoir, and it passes through the rest of the loop before it is diluted. The valve took it undiluted.
blocks.text: The broken valve traces back to our own clean-in-place step. We had assumed that 35 % hydrogen peroxide would be diluted once it mixed in the reservoir, and it passes through the rest of the loop before it is diluted. The valve took it undiluted.
blocks.zh: 斷掉的閥可以追溯到我們自己的原地清洗步驟。我們原本假設 35 % 過氧化氫一進儲液槽混合就會被稀釋，實際上它在被稀釋之前就先經過迴路的其餘部分。那個閥承受的是未稀釋的濃度。

blocks.en: The pH data is what this cycle produced. Because the sensor was reading through the KOH additions, we now know how far the pH shifts after a dose, how long the solution takes to rebalance, and how both behave in a growing culture instead of in a beaker. Those are the three numbers automatic pH correction needs, and they are what cycle 8 is built on.
blocks.text: The pH data is what this cycle produced. Because the sensor was reading through the KOH additions, we now know how far the pH shifts after a dose, how long the solution takes to rebalance, and how both behave in a growing culture instead of in a beaker. Those are the three numbers automatic pH correction needs, and they are what cycle 8 is built on.
blocks.zh: pH 數據才是這個循環產出的東西。因為感測器是在 KOH 加藥過程中持續讀取，我們現在知道加一次藥之後 pH 會位移多少、溶液需要多久才重新平衡，以及這兩件事在生長中的培養裡（而不是在燒杯裡）如何表現。這正是自動 pH 校正所需的三個數字，也是循環 8 所建立的基礎。

blocks.en: The protectant samples drawn before the break were not assayed. Cycle 8 was already built and ready to run by then, so we abandoned this cycle’s samples rather than bring them forward. After the valve went, the loss of medium made the photometer readings entirely unreliable.
blocks.text: The protectant samples drawn before the break were not assayed. Cycle 8 was already built and ready to run by then, so we abandoned this cycle’s samples rather than bring them forward. After the valve went, the loss of medium made the photometer readings entirely unreliable.
blocks.zh: 斷裂前取出的保護劑樣品沒有做檢測。那時循環 8 已經建好並隨時可以跑，因此我們捨棄了這個循環的樣品，沒有把它們往前帶。閥斷掉之後，培養液的流失讓光度計讀值完全不可靠。

blocks.en: The sensors behaved the opposite way to how we expected at the break, and that is the transferable result. The valve that failed sits at the serum bottle inlet, the lowest-pressure point in the loop, so we expected a leak there to drop the pressure. Instead the lumen-side pressure rose, feed from about 0.19 to 0.37 bar, while the transmembrane pressure barely moved, because the module keeps seeing the same difference across it either way. Pressure monitoring on its own cannot detect a leak, and the next build needs a dedicated leak detector, not an inference drawn from the transducers.
blocks.text: The sensors behaved the opposite way to how we expected at the break, and that is the transferable result. The valve that failed sits at the serum bottle inlet, the lowest-pressure point in the loop, so we expected a leak there to drop the pressure. Instead the lumen-side pressure rose, feed from about 0.19 to 0.37 bar, while the transmembrane pressure barely moved, because the module keeps seeing the same difference across it either way. Pressure monitoring on its own cannot detect a leak, and the next build needs a dedicated leak detector, not an inference drawn from the transducers.
blocks.zh: 斷裂時感測器的表現與我們預期的相反，而這正是可以帶走的結果。失效的那個閥位在血清瓶入口，是迴路中壓力最低的一點，所以我們預期那裡漏液會讓壓力下降。結果管腔側壓力反而上升，進料從約 0.19 升到 0.37 bar，而跨膜壓差幾乎沒有動，因為不論如何模組兩側看到的差值都一樣。單靠壓力監測無法偵測漏液，下一版建構需要一個專用的漏液偵測器，而不是從傳感器推論出來的判斷。

blocks.en: The OD600 trace climbed at the same moment, which is also not growth: with too little liquid left to push cells through the flow cuvette they settled in it, and a settled cuvette reads high. That is the mechanism behind the reading failure, and it is why the optical record ends where it does.
blocks.text: The OD600 trace climbed at the same moment, which is also not growth: with too little liquid left to push cells through the flow cuvette they settled in it, and a settled cuvette reads high. That is the mechanism behind the reading failure, and it is why the optical record ends where it does.
blocks.zh: OD600 曲線在同一時刻往上爬，那也不是生長：剩下的液體太少，無法把細胞推過流量比色槽，細胞便在裡面沉降，而沉降的比色槽會讀得偏高。這就是讀值失效背後的機制，也是光學紀錄為什麼在那裡結束。

blocks.en: OD600, pH and feed flow across the two recordings, joined at the dashed seam. The pH falls through the first six hours and steps back up after a KOH dose, which is the response this cycle set out to measure. The OD jump after 37 hours is a reading failure, not growth.
blocks.text: OD600, pH and feed flow across the two recordings, joined at the dashed seam. The pH falls through the first six hours and steps back up after a KOH dose, which is the response this cycle set out to measure. The OD jump after 37 hours is a reading failure, not growth.
blocks.zh: 兩段記錄接起來的 OD600、pH 與進料流量，接縫以虛線標示。pH 在前六小時下降，在一次 KOH 加藥後往上跳一階，這就是這個循環想量測的反應。37 小時之後的 OD 跳升是讀值失效，不是生長。

blocks.en: Every sensor on the loop across the run, with the sampling and base-addition events marked and the leak shaded pink from 37 hours. The pressure panels are what the Learn step argues from: feed pressure rises into the leak instead of falling, and the transmembrane pressure stays steady. The team’s own caption numbers this run as cycle 4; the trace starts at 14 October 10:56, which is this cycle.
blocks.text: Every sensor on the loop across the run, with the sampling and base-addition events marked and the leak shaded pink from 37 hours. The pressure panels are what the Learn step argues from: feed pressure rises into the leak instead of falling, and the transmembrane pressure stays steady. The team’s own caption numbers this run as cycle 4; the trace starts at 14 October 10:56, which is this cycle.
blocks.zh: 整段運轉中迴路上的每一顆感測器，取樣與加鹼事件都有標示，漏液從 37 小時起以粉紅色底標出。壓力那幾格就是學習步驟論證的依據：進料壓力在漏液時上升而非下降，而跨膜壓差保持穩定。團隊自己的圖說把這次運轉編為循環 4；曲線從 10 月 14 日 10:56 開始，就是這個循環。

blocks.en: A growth rate was predicted and registered on 1 October, with a pass band set before the run, and the run came back at 0.286 h−1 inside it. That is the one place on this page where a number was committed to before the experiment that produced it.
blocks.text: A growth rate was predicted and registered on 1 October, with a pass band set before the run, and the run came back at 0.286 h−1 inside it. That is the one place on this page where a number was committed to before the experiment that produced it.
blocks.zh: 生長速率在 10 月 1 日就先預測並登錄，通過區間也在運轉前設定，而運轉結果是 0.286 h−1，落在區間內。這是本頁唯一一處在產生數字的實驗之前就先承諾數字的地方。

blocks.en: Show details What the fouling trend does and does not establish, and the control this pair of runs never had.
blocks.text: Show details What the fouling trend does and does not establish, and the control this pair of runs never had.
blocks.zh: 顯示細節 積垢趨勢建立了什麼、沒有建立什麼，以及這一對運轉從來沒有的那個對照。

blocks.en: The starch-iodide papers from the clean-in-place rinses. The peroxide falls with each 1 L wash until a paper no longer reacts, which is what the procedure is validated against instead of being assumed complete.
blocks.text: The starch-iodide papers from the clean-in-place rinses. The peroxide falls with each 1 L wash until a paper no longer reacts, which is what the procedure is validated against instead of being assumed complete.
blocks.zh: 原地清洗沖洗過程的澱粉碘化鉀試紙。每次 1 L 沖洗都讓過氧化氫下降一些，直到試紙不再反應，程序就是以此驗證，而不是假設它已經完成。

blocks.en: Growth against pH over the first eighteen hours. The culture stops growing steeply at about six hours, which is the same point the pH passes 6.5, the lower bound this cycle’s design step set for B. subtilis. One run, and the two curves are not independent of each other. This is the coincidence that justified automating the dosing; it is not a demonstration that pH alone caps growth.
blocks.text: Growth against pH over the first eighteen hours. The culture stops growing steeply at about six hours, which is the same point the pH passes 6.5, the lower bound this cycle’s design step set for B. subtilis. One run, and the two curves are not independent of each other. This is the coincidence that justified automating the dosing; it is not a demonstration that pH alone caps growth.
blocks.zh: 前十八小時的生長與 pH 對照。培養在約六小時停止陡升，而那也正是 pH 越過 6.5 的時點，也就是這個循環的設計步驟為 B. subtilis 設下的下限。只有一次運轉，而且這兩條曲線彼此並不獨立。這個巧合足以支持把加藥自動化；它並不證明單憑 pH 就限制了生長。

blocks.en: The 2.0 to 3.8 kPa rise is the rising trend a fouling measurement is supposed to show, and it is measured against a clean-water sweep on the same module, so the valves and fittings come out of the number instead of being left in it. It is still one run on one module. Nothing had to be cleaned, no replacement interval follows from it, and none of the controller’s fouling thresholds was reached: permeability below 70 % of steady state, or a friction or shear ratio above 1.3.
blocks.text: The 2.0 to 3.8 kPa rise is the rising trend a fouling measurement is supposed to show, and it is measured against a clean-water sweep on the same module, so the valves and fittings come out of the number instead of being left in it. It is still one run on one module. Nothing had to be cleaned, no replacement interval follows from it, and none of the controller’s fouling thresholds was reached: permeability below 70 % of steady state, or a friction or shear ratio above 1.3.
blocks.zh: 2.0 到 3.8 kPa 的上升，就是一個積垢量測應該呈現的上升趨勢，而且是對照同一個模組上的清水掃描來量的，所以閥與接頭被扣除在這個數字之外，而不是留在裡面。它仍然是一個模組上的一次運轉。期間不需要做任何清洗，也推不出更換週期，而控制器的積垢門檻也沒有被觸及：透過率低於穩態的 70 %，或摩擦或剪切比高於 1.3。

blocks.en: Neither October run included a B. subtilis 168 control under the same conditions, so the two strains have still never been compared in the reactor, and the yield argument that moved the project to WB800 rests on cycle 6 against cycle 5 rather than on a controlled pair. No samples were taken for cell counting either, so the in-line OD600 has not been checked against a cell concentration.

blocks.zh: 十月的兩次運轉都沒有在相同條件下加入 B. subtilis 168 對照，因此兩株菌在反應器中從未被比較過，而把計畫推向 WB800 的產量論證，靠的是循環 6 對循環 5，而不是一組對照配對。也沒有取樣做細胞計數，因此線上 OD600 從未對照細胞濃度檢核過。

blocks.en: A fourth integrated run was planned in quick succession, to replicate this result and document a complete growth curve with pH, OD and pressure all reading reliably. It ran on 18 October and is cycle 8. It gave the complete growth curve and the automated pH control, so what is still outstanding is narrower than it was: a replicate of this cycle’s own numbers, since cycle 8 changed the dosing and the cleaning procedure at the same time, which makes it a new condition and not a repeat.

blocks.zh: 原本計畫緊接著做第四次整合運轉，以重現這個結果，並在 pH、OD 與壓力都讀得可靠的情況下記錄完整的生長曲線。它在 10 月 18 日跑了，就是循環 8。它給出了完整的生長曲線與自動 pH 控制，因此還欠的東西比原先窄了：欠的是這個循環自身數字的重複驗證，因為循環 8 同時改了加藥與清洗程序，使它成為一個新的條件，而不是一次重複。

blocks.en: The loop held its own pH for seventy-seven hours, and then ate four valves doing it
blocks.text: The loop held its own pH for seventy-seven hours, and then ate four valves doing it
blocks.zh: 迴路自行維持 pH 七十七小時，過程中吃掉了四個閥
結果

blocks.en: Automated KOH dosing held the medium at pH 7 with nobody present, and the culture reached a higher OD600 than any earlier cycle. Nine shell-side samples to 72 hours put ACC deaminase at 2.5 to 6.5 µg/mL, peaking at 12 h, each drawn by closing the pinch valve for one minute.
blocks.text: Automated KOH dosing held the medium at pH 7 with nobody present, and the culture reached a higher OD600 than any earlier cycle. Nine shell-side samples to 72 hours put ACC deaminase at 2.5 to 6.5 µg/mL, peaking at 12 h, each drawn by closing the pinch valve for one minute.
blocks.zh: 自動 KOH 加藥在無人在場的情況下把培養液維持在 pH 7，而培養達到的 OD600 高於任何先前的循環。到 72 小時共九個殼側樣品，ACC 去胺酶為 2.5 到 6.5 µg/mL，在 12 h 達到高峰，每一個樣品都是靠把夾管閥關閉一分鐘取出的。
下一步改動

blocks.en: Alkaline-resistant Luer valves on the dosing line. KOH corroded four of the ordinary ones in succession, and dosing had to go back to a person with a pipette.
blocks.text: Alkaline-resistant Luer valves on the dosing line. KOH corroded four of the ordinary ones in succession, and dosing had to go back to a person with a pipette.
blocks.zh: 加藥管路改用耐鹼的 Luer 閥。KOH 接連腐蝕了四個普通閥，加藥只好退回由人拿移液管進行。
D設計

blocks.en: With pH, OD and pressure all reading reliably after cycle 7, we ran the next cycle in quick succession to replicate the result and document a complete growth curve. Two additions take manual handling out of it. The sampling Luer valve was automated, and a serum bottle of 1 M KOH was added that pumps into the medium in fixed amounts. Both are driven remotely from a computer, which is the point: a farmer running this vessel should not have to stand over it with a pipette.

Two additions take manual handling out of it. The sampling Luer valve was automated, and a serum bottle of 1 M KOH was added that pumps into the medium in fixed amounts. Both are driven remotely from a computer, which is the point: a farmer running this vessel should not have to stand over it with a pipette.
blocks.zh: 循環 7 之後 pH、OD 與壓力都讀得可靠，我們緊接著跑下一個循環，以重現這個結果並記錄完整的生長曲線。兩項新增把人工操作移出流程。取樣用的 Luer 閥自動化了，並加上一瓶 1 M KOH 的血清瓶，以固定量打進培養液。兩者都從電腦遠端驅動，而這正是重點：操作這個容器的農友，不應該還得拿著移液管站在旁邊。

blocks.en: The clean-in-place procedure also changed in answer to cycle 7. Rather than adding concentrated peroxide into the assembled system, we now mix the 100 mL of 35 % hydrogen peroxide into 900 mL of distilled water before it enters the bioreactor, so no component ever meets peroxide at full concentration. That is the direct correction for the valve cycle 7 broke.

blocks.zh: 原地清洗程序也為了回應循環 7 而改變。我們不再把濃過氧化氫加進已組裝的系統，而是在它進入生物反應器之前，先把 100 mL 的 35 % 過氧化氫混進 900 mL 蒸餾水，讓任何元件都不會碰到全濃度的過氧化氫。這就是對循環 7 弄壞那個閥的直接更正。
B建構

blocks.en: The build is close to cycles 6 and 7, with two automated Luer valves, a serum bottle and one additional peristaltic pump. The automated valves remove the manual handling that could break components through human error, and the serum bottle and its pump automate the pH adjustment, which is the part of operating the vessel that otherwise has to happen on a schedule.
blocks.text: The build is close to cycles 6 and 7, with two automated Luer valves, a serum bottle and one additional peristaltic pump. The automated valves remove the manual handling that could break components through human error, and the serum bottle and its pump automate the pH adjustment, which is the part of operating the vessel that otherwise has to happen on a schedule.
blocks.zh: 建構與循環 6 和 7 接近，加上兩個自動 Luer 閥、一個血清瓶與一顆額外的蠕動幫浦。自動閥移除了可能因人為失誤弄壞元件的手動操作，而血清瓶與它的幫浦把 pH 調整自動化，那是操作這個容器時原本必須按時程進行的部分。

blocks.en: Both valves are driven by STS3215 bus serial servos over UART, the part Owl Lab recommended in September after we found the PGA9685 driver could miss a commanded angle by five degrees, which on a valve is enough to spike the pressure and burst a tube. The shell Luer valve and the pinch valve run on the same bus, so one command opens the shell side and pinches the lumen return together, and the pressure transducers record what that does.
blocks.text: Both valves are driven by STS3215 bus serial servos over UART, the part Owl Lab recommended in September after we found the PGA9685 driver could miss a commanded angle by five degrees, which on a valve is enough to spike the pressure and burst a tube. The shell Luer valve and the pinch valve run on the same bus, so one command opens the shell side and pinches the lumen return together, and the pressure transducers record what that does.
blocks.zh: 兩個閥都由透過 UART 的 STS3215 總線串列伺服馬達驅動，這個零件是 Owl Lab 在九月建議的，當時我們發現 PGA9685 驅動器可能偏離指令角度達五度，而在閥上這已足以讓壓力飆升並把管子爆開。殼側 Luer 閥與夾管閥在同一條總線上，因此一道指令就能同時打開殼側與夾住管腔回流，而壓力傳感器會記錄這麼做的結果。

blocks.en: The dosing pump sits ahead of the feeding Luer valve and delivers up to about 60 mL/min, so the same line delivers base and any external feed, TB medium or antibiotic. The control law is two numbers: below pH 6.8 the pump adds 5 mL of 1 M KOH a minute until the reading returns to 7.0. Both come from cycle 7’s record of how far a dose shifts the pH and how long a growing culture takes to pull it back down.

blocks.zh: 加藥幫浦位在進料 Luer 閥之前，輸送量最高約 60 mL/min，因此同一條管路既送鹼，也送任何外部補料、TB 培養基或抗生素。控制法則只有兩個數字：pH 低於 6.8 時，幫浦每分鐘加入 5 mL 的 1 M KOH，直到讀值回到 7.0。兩者都來自循環 7 關於一次加藥會把 pH 位移多少、以及生長中的培養要多久把它拉回來的紀錄。

blocks.en: The run started on 18 October 2026 and lasted 77 hours. Automated pH control worked: when the reading drops below 6.8 the pump adds KOH until it returns to 7, and the mechanism held the medium there. The controller logged 53 automatic base doses across the run, and the 0.70 bar pressure trip was armed throughout and never needed, the highest pressure reached being 0.57 bar.

blocks.en: The KOH itself then became the failure. It degraded the Luer valve on the dosing line, breaking it in half and causing another leak, and after four valves broke consecutively we abandoned pumping. For the rest of the run we added 25 mL TB, 20 mL of 1 M KOH and 100 µL of 25 mg/mL erythromycin to the medium reservoir every morning. The OD600 curve showed continual growth and reached a higher value than any previous cycle, with the photometer reading to OD 3.34 before the top of its range.

blocks.en: Protectant was drawn from the shell side using the pinch valve, the pressure sensors and the automated Luer valve system, through to 72 hours. A draw is a fixed sequence: the sensor sampling interval drops from 300 s to 5 s so the pressure change is resolved, the shell valve opens to the collection bottle, the pinch valve closes the line from the membrane outlet to the serum bottle for 60 seconds, then releases and the shell valve shuts. One minute of pinch yields roughly 20 to 30 mL of permeate. The assays on those samples are the first protectant time course this project has over three days.
